Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      const apiError = handleAPIError(error);\n      showToast({\n        message:\n          typeof apiError === 'string'\n            ? apiError\n            : (apiError as any).message || 'An authentication error occurred',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper scroll>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 px-6 py-8\">\n        <SanctuaryBackground />\n        <VStack className=\"w-full max-w-[460px] self-center gap-6\">\n          {onBack && (\n            <Box className=\"self-start\">\n              <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={onBack} className=\"pl-0\">\n                <HStack className=\"gap-1 items-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-lg\">ΓåÉ</Text>\n                  <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">Back</ButtonText>\n                </HStack>\n              </Button>\n            </Box>\n          )}\n\n          <VStack className=\"gap-5 items-center pt-4\">\n            <BreathAnimation delay={100}>\n              <LivingGlow\n                active\n                size={132}\n                style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}\n              >\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n                  <Box\n                    className=\"px-4 py-1 rounded-full border\"\n                    style={{\n                      backgroundColor: `${accent.action}12`,\n                      borderColor: `${accent.action}28`,\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Text\n                      className=\"text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.5px]\"\n                      style={{ color: accent.action }}\n                    >\n                      ENTER THE SANCTUARY\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                  <Heading\n                    size=\"3xl\"\n                    className=\"text-center font-bold tracking-[-1.2px]\"\n                    style={{ color: text.primary }}\n                  >\n                    Gurudevi\n                  </Heading>\n                </VStack>\n              </LivingGlow>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <BreathAnimation delay={200}>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-center max-w-[320px]\">\n                {t('auth.tagline') || 'Enter the Sanctuary of Learning'}\n              </Text>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap justify-center\">\n              {ENTRY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-phase-surface border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n          </VStack>\n\n          <Box\n            className=\"p-0 overflow-hidden border-t-4 bg-phase-surface border-phase-border rounded-3xl\"\n            style={{ borderTopColor: accent.action }}\n          >\n            <VStack className=\"gap-6 p-6\">\n              <Box className=\"p-5 rounded-2xl bg-phase-surface/40 border border-phase-border\">\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-muted font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                    SANCTUARY ENTRY\n                  </Text>\n                  <Heading size=\"sm\" className=\"text-phase-primary\">\n                    {isSignUp ? 'Begin with a held identity' : 'Return to your learning sanctuary'}\n                  </Heading>\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">\n                    {isSignUp\n                      ? handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-tertiary\">{t('onboarding.skip')}</ButtonText>\n          </Button>\n        </VStack>\n      </VStack>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper>\n Auditor\n *\n * Scans Theme.ts and phaseMatrix for contrast violations using APCA and WCAG 2.1.\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/audit-theme.ts\n */\n\nimport { colors, phaseMatrix, resolvePhaseTokens } from '../src/theme/Theme';\nimport { checkAccessibility, toHex } from '../src/utils/a11yUtils';\nimport { TemporalPhase } from '../src/context/types';\n\nconst PHASES: TemporalPhase[] = ['predawn', 'dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'dusk', 'night'];\nconst MODES: ('light' | 'dark')[] = ['light', 'dark'];\n\nconsole.log('\\x1b[36m%s\\x1b[0m', '--- GURUDEVI THEME ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT ---');\nconsole.log('Validating Sanctuary tokens against WCAG 2.1 and APCA Standards...\\n');\n\nlet violations = 0;\nlet totalChecks = 0;\n\nfunction report(\n  label: string,\n  fg: string,\n  bg: string,\n  requirement: { wcag?: number; apca?: number },\n) {\n  totalChecks++;\n  const fgHex = toHex(fg);\n  const bgHex = toHex(bg);\n  const { ratio, apca, apcaRating } = checkAccessibility(fgHex, bgHex);\n\n  let failed = false;\n  const details = [];\n\n  if (requirement.wcag && ratio < requirement.wcag) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`WCAG: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 (Min ${requirement.wcag})`);\n  }\n\n  if (requirement.apca && Math.abs(apca) < requirement.apca) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`APCA: ${apca.toFixed(1)} Lc (Min ${requirement.apca} - ${apcaRating})`);\n  }\n\n  if (failed) {\n    violations++;\n    console.log(`\\x1b[31m[FAIL]\\x1b[0m ${label}`);\n    console.log(`       - BG: ${bgHex}, FG: ${fgHex}`);\n    console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n  console.log(`\\x1b[32mSUCCESS: All ${totalChecks} checks passed.\\x1b[0m`);\n  process.exit(0);\n} else {\n  console.log(\n    `\\x1b[31mWARNING: Found ${violations} accessibility violations across ${totalChecks} checks.\\x1b[0m`,\n  );\n  // We don't exit with 1 yet to avoid breaking builds until we fix the colors\n void;\n  icon?: React.ReactNode;\n  actions?: ActionItem[];\n  scrollY?: SharedValue<number>;\n  disabled?: boolean;\n  bottomInset?: number; // New prop for safe area handling\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst FAB_SIZE = 72; // Slightly larger for the art\nconst FAB_HIT_SLOP = 10;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SIZE = 48;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING = 12;\nconst LONG_PRESS_DURATION = 400; // milliseconds\nconst SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;\n\n// Context-aware configuration\ntype IconComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n\nconst fabConfig:       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const await accountPin.verifyPin(account.accountId, values.pin);\n        if (!ok) {\n          throw new Error('PIN did not match this account.');\n        }\n        await const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = si
- ze / sizeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - Philosophy: Simple, reusable foundation for UI cards\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Pressable, Platform } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, { useSharedValue, TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface SanctuaryCardProps {\n  title?: string;\n  children: any;\n  footer?: any;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  onLongPress?: () => void;\n  href?: string;\n  target?: '_blank' | '_self';\n  elevated?: boolean;\n  style?: any;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL = 1.0;\nconst LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED = 1.02;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst SanctuaryCard: FC<SanctuaryCardProps> = ({\n  title,\n  children,\n  footer,\n  onPress,\n  onLongPress,\n  href,\n  target = '_self',\n  elevated = false,\n  style,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  // Hover state - only meaningful on web (desktop pointer devices)\n  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);\n\n  // Shared value for lift animation\n  const scale = useSharedValue(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION: LIFT EFFECT (when pressable)\n  // });\n\n  const handlePressIn = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePressOut = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // RENDER: Container Level\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const overflow-hidden\n                ${elevated ? 'shadow-xl shadow-black/20' : ''}\n                ${hovered && Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'opacity-90 scale-[1.01]' : ''}\n                ${className || ''}\n            `}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"p-6\">\n        {/* Title Section */}\n        {title && <Text className=\"text-xl font-bold text-phase-text-primary mb-4\">{title}</Text>}\n\n        {/* Children Content */}\n        <Box className=\"gap-4\">{children}</Box>\n\n        {/* Footer Section */}\n        {footer && (\n          <VStack className=\"mt-4 gap-4\">\n            <Box className=\"h-px bg-white/5 opacity-30\" />\n            {footer}\n          </VStack>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress || href) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable\n        onPress={onPress}\n        onLongPress={onLongPress}\n        onPressIn={handlePressIn}\n        onPressOut={handlePressOut}\n        onHoverIn={Platform.OS === 'web' ? ).current;\n\n  const color = phase === 'past' ? * Determines the temporal phase based on current time\n * - Predawn:   4 AM - 6 AM  (dark)\n * - Dawn:      6 AM - 9 AM  (light)\n * - Morning:   9 AM - 12 PM (light)\n * - Afternoon: 12 PM - 5 PM (light)\n * - Dusk:      5 PM - 8 PM  (dark)\n * - Night:     8 PM - 4 AM  (dark, wraps midnight)\n */\nexport function getTemporalPhase(): TemporalPhase {\n  const hour = new Date().getHours();\n  if available\n    const totalMemory = Device.totalMemory;\n\n    if (!totalMemory) {\n      // If we can't detect, assume medium tier to be safe\n      return { tier: 'medium', memoryGB: 4 };\n    }\n\n    const memoryGB = totalMemory / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);\n\n    let tier: DeviceTier;\n    if (memoryGB < 3) {\n      tier = 'low';\n    } else if (memoryGB < 6) {\n      tier = 'medium';\n    } else {\n      tier = 'high';\n    }\n\n    return { tier, memoryGB };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('Failed to detect device tier:', error);\n    return { tier: 'medium', memoryGB: 4 };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Detects network quality based on connection info\n */\nexport async function detectNetworkQuality(): Promise<NetworkQuality> {\n  try {\n    const netInfo = await NetInfo.fetch();\n\n    if (!netInfo.isConnected) {\n      return 'offline';\n    }\n\n    // Check connection type and effective type\n    const type = netInfo.type;\n    const details = netInfo.details as any;\n\n    // If we have cellular connection, check the type\n    if (type === 'cellular') {\n      const cellularGeneration = details?.cellularGeneration;\n\n      if (cellularGeneration === '5g') {\n        return 'excellent';\n      } else if (cellularGeneration === '4g') {\n        return 'good';\n      } else if (cellularGeneration === '3g') {\n        return 'fair';\n      } else {\n        return on settings and reality\n */\nexport function computeEffectiveFidelity(\n  fidelityLevel: 'auto' | 'low' | 'high',\n  deviceTier: DeviceTier,\n): 'low' | 'high' {\n  // If user explicitly chose, respect their choice\n  if (fidelityLevel === 'low') return 'low';\n  if (fidelityLevel === 'high') return 'high';\n\n  // Auto mode: base on device tier\n  return deviceTier === 'low' ? Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      const apiError = handleAPIError(error);\n      showToast({\n        message:\n          typeof apiError === 'string'\n            ? apiError\n            : (apiError as any).message || 'An authentication error occurred',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper scroll>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 px-6 py-8\">\n        <SanctuaryBackground />\n        <VStack className=\"w-full max-w-[460px] self-center gap-6\">\n          {onBack && (\n            <Box className=\"self-start\">\n              <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={onBack} className=\"pl-0\">\n                <HStack className=\"gap-1 items-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-lg\">ΓåÉ</Text>\n                  <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">Back</ButtonText>\n                </HStack>\n              </Button>\n            </Box>\n          )}\n\n          <VStack className=\"gap-5 items-center pt-4\">\n            <BreathAnimation delay={100}>\n              <LivingGlow\n                active\n                size={132}\n                style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}\n              >\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n                  <Box\n                    className=\"px-4 py-1 rounded-full border\"\n                    style={{\n                      backgroundColor: `${accent.action}12`,\n                      borderColor: `${accent.action}28`,\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Text\n                      className=\"text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.5px]\"\n                      style={{ color: accent.action }}\n                    >\n                      ENTER THE SANCTUARY\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                  <Heading\n                    size=\"3xl\"\n                    className=\"text-center font-bold tracking-[-1.2px]\"\n                    style={{ color: text.primary }}\n                  >\n                    Gurudevi\n                  </Heading>\n                </VStack>\n              </LivingGlow>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <BreathAnimation delay={200}>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-center max-w-[320px]\">\n                {t('auth.tagline') || 'Enter the Sanctuary of Learning'}\n              </Text>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap justify-center\">\n              {ENTRY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-phase-surface border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n          </VStack>\n\n          <Box\n            className=\"p-0 overflow-hidden border-t-4 bg-phase-surface border-phase-border rounded-3xl\"\n            style={{ borderTopColor: accent.action }}\n          >\n            <VStack className=\"gap-6 p-6\">\n              <Box className=\"p-5 rounded-2xl bg-phase-surface/40 border border-phase-border\">\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-muted font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                    SANCTUARY ENTRY\n                  </Text>\n                  <Heading size=\"sm\" className=\"text-phase-primary\">\n                    {isSignUp ? 'Begin with a held identity' : 'Return to your learning sanctuary'}\n                  </Heading>\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">\n                    {isSignUp\n                      ? handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-tertiary\">{t('onboarding.skip')}</ButtonText>\n          </Button>\n        </VStack>\n      </VStack>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper>\n * LOTUS PETAL FAB - Floating Action Button\n *\n * A petal-shaped floating action button with:\n * - Golden Lotus Art image\n * - Breathing animation (4-second cycle)\n * - Context-aware icons per tab\n * - Press animation with haptic feedback\n * - Floating bubble physics for dragging\n *\n * Philosophy: Organic, living UI that breathes with intention\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback, useState, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, PanResponder, Dimensions, Image } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, {\n  useAnimatedStyle,\n  withRepeat,\n  withTiming,\n  withSequence,\n  withSpring,\n  interpolate,\n  SharedValue,\n  Extrapolate,\n  useSharedValue,\n  Easing,\n  runOnJS,\n} from 'react-native-reanimated';\nimport * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';\nimport { Flower2, Plus, MessageCircle, Upload, Edit } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { useAccessibility } from '../hooks/useAccessibility';\n\n// ============================================================================\n// TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ntype TabType = 'self' | 'classroom' | 'community' | 'library' | 'profile';\n\nexport interface ActionItem {\n  label: string;\n  onPress: () => void;\n  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n}\n\ninterface LotusPetalFABProps {\n  currentTab?: TabType;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  icon?: React.ReactNode;\n  actions?: ActionItem[];\n  scrollY?: SharedValue<number>;\n  disabled?: boolean;\n  bottomInset?: number; // New prop for safe area handling\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst FAB_SIZE = 72; // Slightly larger for the art\nconst FAB_HIT_SLOP = 10;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SIZE = 48;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING = 12;\nconst LONG_PRESS_DURATION = 400; // milliseconds\nconst SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;\n\n// Context-aware configuration\ntype IconComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n\nconst fabConfig: Record<TabType, { IconComponent: IconComponentType; label: string }> = {\n  self: {\n    IconComponent: Flower2,\n    label: 'Log mood',\n  },\n  classroom: {\n    IconComponent: Plus,\n    label: 'Create lesson',\n  },\n  community: {\n    IconComponent: MessageCircle,\n    label: 'Post announcement',\n  },\n  library: {\n    IconComponent: Upload,\n    label: 'Upload resource',\n  },\n  profile: {\n    IconComponent: Edit,\n    label: 'Edit profile',\n  },\n};\n\nconst LOTUS_IMAGE = require('../../assets/images/lotus_bloom.png');\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LotusPetalFAB: FC<LotusPetalFABProps> = ({\n  currentTab = 'self',\n  onPress,\n  icon,\n  actions,\n  scrollY,\n  disabled = true,\n  bottomInset = Theme.spacing.lg, // Default value if not provided\n}) => {\n  const { isReduceMotionEnabled, announce } = useAccessibility();\n\n  // TEMPORARY: Return null if disabled to completely hide the FAB\n  if (disabled) return null;\n\n  // Shared value for press animation\n  const pressScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  // Shared value for breathing animation\n  const breathingScale = useSharedValue(0.95);\n  // Position for dragging\n  const translateX = useSharedValue(0);\n  const translateY = useSharedValue(0);\n  // Base position accumulator\n  const baseX = useRef(0);\n  const baseY = useRef(0);\n  // State for showing action menu\n  const [showActions, setShowActions] = useState(false);\n  const actionMenuScale = useSharedValue(0);\n  // Track long press\n  const longPressTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n\n  // Memoize current configuration to avoid unnecessary recalculations\n  const config = useMemo(() => fabConfig[currentTab], [currentTab]);\n  const IconComponent = config.IconComponent;\n\n  // Safe haptic feedback wrapper\n  const triggerHaptic = useCallback(async () => {\n    try {\n      await Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Haptic feedback not available');\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // Pan responder for drag functionality\n  const panResponder = useRef(\n    PanResponder.create({\n      onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,\n      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_, gestureState) => {\n        return isDragging || Math.abs(gestureState.dx) > 5 || Math.abs(gestureState.dy) > 5;\n      },\n      onPanResponderGrant: () => {\n        longPressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {\n          setIsDragging(true);\n          triggerHaptic();\n          // Slight lift effect\n          pressScale.value = withSpring(1.1);\n        }, LONG_PRESS_DURATION);\n      },\n      onPanResponderMove: (_, gestureState) => {\n        if (isDragging) {\n          translateX.value = baseX.current + gestureState.dx;\n          translateY.value = baseY.current + gestureState.dy;\n        }\n      },\n      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gestureState) => {\n        if (longPressTimer.current) {\n          clearTimeout(longPressTimer.current);\n          longPressTimer.current = null;\n        }\n\n        if (isDragging) {\n          baseX.current += gestureState.dx;\n          baseY.current += gestureState.dy;\n          setIsDragging(false);\n          // Spring back slightly on release (bubble effect)\n          pressScale.value = withSpring(1.0);\n\n          // Optional: Snap back if near edge? For now, free floating.\n        } else {\n          const moved = Math.abs(gestureState.dx) > 5 || Math.abs(gestureState.dy) > 5;\n          if (!moved) {\n            handlePress();\n          }\n        }\n      },\n    }),\n  ).current;\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION INITIALIZATION\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!disabled && !isReduceMotionEnabled) {\n      breathingScale.value = 0.95;\n      breathingScale.value = withRepeat(\n        withTiming(1.02, {\n          duration: 3000,\n          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),\n        }),\n        -1,\n        true,\n      );\n    } else {\n      breathingScale.value = withTiming(1.0, { duration: 200 });\n    }\n  }, [disabled, isReduceMotionEnabled]);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION STYLES\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const breathingStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: breathingScale.value }],\n    };\n  });\n\n  const pressStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: pressScale.value }],\n    };\n  });\n\n  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {\n    if (disabled) return;\n\n    if (actions && actions.length > 0) {\n      triggerHaptic();\n      setShowActions(!showActions);\n      actionMenuScale.value = withSpring(showActions ? 0 : 1, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n      announce(showActions ? 'Actions menu closed' : 'Actions menu opened');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (onPress) {\n      triggerHaptic();\n      pressScale.value = withSequence(\n        withTiming(0.85, { duration: 100 }),\n        withSpring(1.0, { damping: 12, stiffness: 200 }),\n      );\n      onPress();\n    }\n  }, [disabled, onPress, actions, showActions, triggerHaptic]);\n\n  const actionMenuStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: actionMenuScale.value }, { translateY: -10 }], // Pop up slightly\n      opacity: actionMenuScale.value,\n    } as any;\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    actionMenuScale.value = withSpring(showActions ? 1 : 0, {\n      damping: 15,\n      stiffness: 150,\n    });\n  }, [showActions]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return () => {\n      if (longPressTimer.current) {\n        clearTimeout(longPressTimer.current);\n      }\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const scrollStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    if (!scrollY) return {};\n    return {\n      transform: [\n        {\n          translateY: interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, 100], [0, 100], Extrapolate.CLAMP),\n        },\n      ],\n      opacity: interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, 50, 100], [1, 0.5, 0], Extrapolate.CLAMP),\n    };\n  });\n\n  const dragStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ translateX: translateX.value }, { translateY: translateY.value }],\n    } as any;\n  });\n\n  const containerStyle = useMemo(\n    () => [\n      styles.container,\n      { bottom: bottomInset }, // Override bottom with prop\n      breathingStyle,\n      pressStyle,\n      scrollStyle,\n      dragStyle,\n      disabled && styles.disabled,\n    ],\n    [bottomInset, breathingStyle, pressStyle, scrollStyle, dragStyle, disabled],\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <Animated.View\n      {...panResponder.panHandlers}\n      style={containerStyle}\n      accessible={true}\n      accessibilityRole=\"image\" // The FAB itself is an image/button\n      accessibilityLabel={config.label}\n      accessibilityHint={actions && actions.length > 0 ? 'Double tap to view actions' : undefined}\n      accessibilityState={{ disabled, expanded: showActions }}\n      accessibilityActions={[{ name: 'activate', label: 'Activate' }]}\n      onAccessibilityAction={handlePress}\n    >\n      <View style={styles.contentContainer}>\n        {/* Glow Behind */}\n        <View style={styles.glow} />\n\n        {/* Lotus Image */}\n        <Image source={LOTUS_IMAGE} style={styles.lotusImage} resizeMode=\"contain\" />\n\n        {/* Optional Icon Overlay */}\n        {icon && (\n          <View style={styles.iconOverlay}>\n            <>{icon}</>\n          </View>\n        )}\n      </View>\n\n      {/* Action Menu */}\n      {actions && actions.length > 0 && (\n        <Animated.View style={[styles.actionMenu, actionMenuStyle]}>\n          {actions.map((action, index) => (\n            <Pressable\n              key={index}\n              style={styles.actionBubble}\n              onPress={() => {\n                triggerHaptic();\n                action.onPress();\n              }}\n              accessible={true}\n              accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n              accessibilityLabel={action.label}\n            >\n              <View style={styles.actionBubbleContent}>\n                {action.icon && (\n                  <action.icon size={18} color={Theme.colors.lotusDeepPink} strokeWidth={2} />\n                )}\n                <Text style={styles.actionLabel}>{action.label}</Text>\n              </View>\n            </Pressable>\n          ))}\n        </Animated.View>\n      )}\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// STYLES\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  container: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    // bottom set dynamically\n    right: Theme.spacing.lg,\n    zIndex: Theme.zIndex.fab,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  contentContainer: {\n    width: FAB_SIZE,\n    height: FAB_SIZE,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  lotusImage: {\n    width: '100%',\n    height: '100%',\n    zIndex: 2,\n    backgroundColor: 'transparent',\n  },\n  iconOverlay: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    zIndex: 3,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  glow: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    width: FAB_SIZE * 0.8,\n    height: FAB_SIZE * 0.8,\n    borderRadius: FAB_SIZE,\n    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.sanctuarySaffron,\n    opacity: 0.4,\n    shadowColor: Theme.colors.sanctuarySaffron,\n    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 0 },\n    shadowOpacity: 0.8,\n    shadowRadius: 20,\n    elevation: 10,\n    zIndex: 1,\n  },\n  disabled: {\n    opacity: 0.5,\n  },\n  actionMenu: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    bottom: FAB_SIZE + ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING,\n    right: 0,\n    alignItems: 'flex-end',\n  },\n  actionBubble: {\n    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.ink,\n    borderRadius: 24,\n    marginBottom: ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING,\n    paddingHorizontal: 16,\n    paddingVertical: 10,\n    ...Theme.shadows.md,\n    minWidth: 100,\n    borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',\n    borderWidth: 1,\n  },\n  actionBubbleContent: {\n    flexDirection: 'row',\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'flex-end',\n    gap: 8,\n  },\n  actionLabel: {\n    color: Theme.colors.sacredWhite,\n    fontSize: 14,\n    fontWeight: This usually indicates a broken Metro resolution or Circular Dependency.',\n  );\n}\n\nexport default class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {\n  public state: State = {\n    hasError: false,\n    error: null,\n    isRecovering: false,\n  };\n\n  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {\n    return { hasError: true, error, isRecovering: false };\n  }\n\n  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {\n    console.error(`Error in ${this.props.name}:`, error, errorInfo);\n\n    // Recursive protection: If we are already recovering and hit another error, something is fundamentally broken\n    if (this.state.isRecovering) {\n      console.error('Critical: Recursive error detected in ErrorBoundary itself.');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.setState({ isRecovering: true });\n\n    // Call custom error handler if provided\n    this.props.onError?.(error, errorInfo);\n  }\n\n  private handleReset = () => {\n    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, isRecovering: false });\n  };\n\n  private renderSafeFallback() {\n    return (\n      <View style={styles.safeContainer}>\n        <View style={styles.safeCard}>\n          <RNText style={styles.safeTitle}>Sanctuary Disrupted</RNText>\n          <RNText style={styles.safeMessage}>\n            A critical error has occurred. (\n    <HStack className=\"gap-4 w-full\">\n      <SanctuaryButton variant=\"ghost\" action=\"secondary\" onPress={handleSkip} isDisabled={syncing}>\n        {t('common.skip') || 'Skip'}\n      </SanctuaryButton>\n      <SanctuaryButton action=\"primary\" onPress={handleSync} isLoading={syncing} className=\"flex-1\">\n        {syncing ? t('sync.syncing') || 'Syncing...' : t('sync.syncButton') || 'Sync Data'}\n      </SanctuaryButton>\n    </HStack>\n  ) : undefined;\n\n  return (\n    <SanctuaryModal\n      isOpen={isOpen}\n      onClose={handleSkip}\n      title={\n        completed\n          ? t('sync.completeTitle') || 'Sync Complete!'\n          : t('sync.title') || 'Sync Your Data'\n      }\n      footer={footer}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"gap-6\">\n        {/* Confirm-skip warning shown when user tries to skip with unsaved data */}\n        {confirmSkip && !completed && (\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n              <AlertTriangle size={18} className=\"text-phase-accent\" />\n              <Text className=\"font-bold text-phase-text-primary\">\n                {t('sync.skipWarningTitle') || 'Your data will be lost'}\n              </Text>\n            </HStack>\n            <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary text-sm\">\n              {t('sync.skipWarningBody') ||\n                `Skipping will permanently discard ${summary.total} item${summary.total !== 1 ? Would you like to sync it to your new account?'}\n            </Text>\n\n            {/* Data Summary */}\n            <Box className=\"bg-phase-surface rounded-xl border border-white/5 p-4\">\n              <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                {summary.timetablePeriods > 0 && (\n                  <HStack className=\"justify-between\">\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary text-sm\">Timetable Periods</Text>\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-primary font-bold\">\n                      {summary.timetablePeriods}\n <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary text-sm\">Mood Logs</Text>\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-primary font-bold\">{summary.moodLogs}</Text>\n                  </HStack>\n                )}\n                {summary.journalEntries > 0 && (\n                  <HStack className=\"justify-between\">\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary text-sm\">Journal Entries</Text>\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-primary font-bold\">\n                      {summary.journalEntries}\n                    </Text>\n                  </HStack>\n                )}\n                {summary.students > 0 && (\n                  <HStack className=\"justify-between\">\n                    <Text emoji: 'Γ₧ò', label: 'Add' },\n  community: { emoji: '≡ƒÆ¼', label: 'Community' },\n  library: { emoji: '≡ƒôÜ', label: 'Library' },\n  profile: { emoji: '≡ƒæñ', label: 'Profile' },\n  section: { emoji: '≡ƒÅó', label: 'Section' },\n  grade: { emoji: '≡ƒÅ½', label: 'Grade' },\n  principal: { emoji: '≡ƒææ', label: 'Management' },\n  founder: { emoji: '≡ƒÅ¢∩╕Å', label: 'Founder' },\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nexport const LotusPetalFAB: FC<LotusPetalFABProps> = ({\n  currentTab: propTab,\n  onPress: propPress,\n  icon: customIcon,\n  actions: propActions,\n  scrollY,\n  disabled = false,\n  bottomInset = 24,\n  hasActiveGaps: propGaps,\n  gapPriority: propPriority,\n  onBreathingReset: propReset,\n  useGlobal = true,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  const { state: globalState } = useFAB();\n  const { isReduceMotionEnabled } = useAccessibility();\n  const bottomTabPadding = useBottomTabPadding();\n\n  // Reconcile props with global state\n  const currentTab = propTab || globalState.tabType;\n  const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = propReset || globalState.onBreathingReset;\n  const isVisible = useGlobal ? globalState.visible : true;\n  const icon = customIcon || globalState.icon;\n\n  const config = useMemo(() => fabConfig[currentTab] || fabConfig.self, [currentTab]);\n\n  // Reanimated Shared Values\n  const pressScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  const breathingScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  const pulseOpacity = useSharedValue(0.4);\n\n  // Position Shared Values for Draggability\n  const positionX = useSharedValue(0);\n  const positionY = useSharedValue(0);\n  const dragStartX = useRef(0);\n  const dragStartY = useRef(0);\n\n  const [isDrawerVisible, setIsDrawerVisible] = useState(false);\n\n  const clampFabToViewport = useCallback(\n    (x: number, y: number) => {\n      const windowDims = Dimensions.get('window');\n      const maxX = Math.max(FAB_EDGE_MARGIN, windowDims.width - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN);\n      const maxY = Math.max(\n        FAB_EDGE_MARGIN,\n        windowDims.height - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN - (bottomInset + bottomTabPadding),\n      );\n      return {\n        x: Math.max(FAB_EDGE_MARGIN, Math.min(maxX, x)),\n        y: {\n      // Ignore storage failures\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const setDefaultPosition = useCallback(() => {\n    const windowDims = Dimensions.get('window');\n    const preferredX = windowDims.width - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN;\n    const preferredY =\n      windowDims.height - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN - (bottomInset + bottomTabPadding);\n    const next = clampFabToViewport(preferredX,         if (raw) {\n            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n            if (typeof parsed?.x === 'number' && typeof parsed?.y === 'number') {\n              const next = clampFabToViewport(parsed.x, parsed.y);\n              positionX.value = next.x;\n              positionY.value = next.y;\n              initialized = true;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // Ignore and use default position\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!initialized) {\n      setDefaultPosition();\n    }\n  }, [clampFabToViewport, positionX, positionY, positionX.value = next.x;\n      positionY.value = next.y;\n      persistWebPosition(next.x, next.y);\n    });\n    return () => sub.remove();\n  }, [clampFabToViewport, persistWebPosition, positionX, dragStartX.current = positionX.value;\n        dragStartY.current = positionY.value;\n        pressScale.value = withSpring(1.1);\n        hapticLight();\n      },\n      onPanResponderMove: (_, positionY.value = next.y;\n      },\n      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gesture) => {\n        pressScale.value = withSpring(1);\n\n        // Tap\n        if (\n          Math.abs(gesture.dx) < clampFabToViewport(positionX.value, positionY.value);\n        positionX.value = withSpring(next.x, { damping: 15 });\n        positionY.value = withSpring(next.y, { damping: 15 });\n withRepeat(\n        withTiming(1.1, { duration: 4000, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease) }),\n        -1,\n        true,\n      );\n      pulseOpacity.value = withRepeat(\n        withTiming(0.7, { left: positionX.value,\n    top: positionY.value,\n    transform: [{ scale: pressScale.value }],\n  }));\n\n  const breathingStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({\n    transform: [{ scale: breathingScale.value }],\n    opacity: pulseOpacity.value,\n  }));\n\n  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {\n    if (disabled) return;\n    hapticLight();\n\n    if (actions && actions.length > 0) {\n      setIsDrawerVisible(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (onPress) {\n      pressScale.value = withSequence(withTiming(0.9, { duration: 100 }), withSpring(1));\n      onPress();\n    }\n  }, [disabled, onPress, actions]);\n\n  if (!isVisible) return null;\n\n  return (\n    <Box className=\"absolute inset-0 z-[1000] pointer-events-none\">\n      <Animated.View\n        {...panResponder.panHandlers}\n        style={[containerStyle]}\n        className=\"absolute w-14 h-14 items-center justify-center pointer-events-auto\"\n      >\n        {/* Breathing Glow */}\n        <Animated.View\n          style={breathingStyle}\n          className={`\n                        absolute w-[72px] h-[72px] rounded-full\n                        ${hasActiveGaps ? 'bg-phase-error opacity-60' : 'bg-phase-accent opacity-40'}\n                    `}\n        />\n\n        {/* Main FAB Circle */}\n        <Box\n          className={`\n                        w-14 h-14 rounded-full items-center justify-center bg-phase-accent\n                        shadow-xl shadow-black/30 border-2 border-white/10\n                        ${className || ''}\n                    `}\n        >\n          {hasActiveGaps ? (\n            <Text className=\"text-2xl\">Γ¥ù</Text>\n          ) : icon ? (\n            icon\n          ) : (\n            <Text className=\"text-2xl\">{config.emoji}</Text>\n          )}\n        </Box>\n      </Animated.View>\n\n      {/* Action Drawer */}\n      <UniversalModal isOpen={isDrawerVisible} onClose={() => setIsDrawerVisible(false)}>\n        <Pressable\n          accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-black/50 justify-end\"\n          onPress={() => setIsDrawerVisible(false)}\n        >\n          <Box className=\"bg-phase-surface rounded-t-[32px] p-8 min-h-[40vh] w-full mt-auto\">\n            <Box text-phase-text-primary mb-2\">\n                {config.label} Actions\n              </Text>\n\n              {onBreathingReset && (\n                <Pressable\n                  accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n                  onPress={() => {\n                    setIsDrawerVisible(false);\n                    onBreathingReset();\n                  }}\n                  className=\"p-4 rounded-xl bg-phase-success/10 active:bg-phase-success/20\"\n                >\n                  <HStack className=\"items-center gap-3\">\n                    <Wind size={20} color=\"#10B981\" strokeWidth={2} />\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-primary font-semibold\">Breathing Reset</Text>\n                  </HStack>\n                </Pressable>\n              )}\n\n              {actions?.map((action, idx) => (\n                <Pressable\n                  key={idx}\n                  onPress={() => {\n                    setIsDrawerVisible(false);\n                    action.onPress();\n                  }}\n                  accessible={true}\n                  accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n                  accessibilityLabel={action.label}\n                  className=\"p-4 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 active:bg-white/10\"\n                >\n                  <HStack className=\"items-center gap-3\">\n                    {action.icon && <action.icon size={20} color=\"#F6BF8C\" strokeWidth={2} />}\n                    <Text className=\"text-phase-text-primary\">{action.label}</Text>\n                  </HStack>\n                </Pressable>\n              ))}\n            </VStack>\n          </Box>\n        </Pressable>\n      </UniversalModal>\n    </Box>\n  );\n};\n\nexport default
