Bell;\n    case 'system':\n      return Info;\n    default:\n      return Info;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {\n  const ts = new Date(dateStr).getTime();\n  if (isNaN(ts)) <Portal>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 bg-black/40\">\n        <Pressable\n          accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n          className=\"absolute inset-0\"\n          onPress={() => {\n            hapticLight();\n            onClose();\n          }}\n        />\n\n        <Animated.View\n          entering={SlideInLeft.duration(800).easing(Easing.out(Easing.exp))}\n          exiting={SlideOutLeft.duration(500)}\n          style={{\n            position: 'absolute',\n            top: 0,\n            left: 0,\n            bottom: 0,\n            width: DRAWER_WIDTH,\n {unreadCount > 0 && (\n                  <Box className=\"bg-phase-accent rounded-full min-w-[20px] h-5 items-center justify-center px-1\">\n                    <Text className=\"text-white '99+' : unreadCount}\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                )}\n              </HStack>\n              <HStack className=\"items-center gap-2\">\n                {unreadCount > 0 && onMarkAllRead && (\n                  <Pressable\n                    accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n                    onPress={() => {\n                      hapticLight();\n                      onMarkAllRead();\n                    }}\n                    hitSlop={10}\n                  >\n                    <Check size={18} color=\"#F6BF8C\" />\n                  </Pressable>\n                )}\n                <Pressable\n                  accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n                  onPress={() => {\n                    hapticLight();\n                    onClose();\n                  }}\n                  hitSlop={10}\n                >\n                  <X size={28} className=\"text-phase-text-secondary\" />\n                </Pressable>\n              </HStack>\n            </HStack>\n\n            <ScrollView\n              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}\n              contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}\n            >\n              {isLoading ? Using react-native-svg to render\n// the matrix as <Rect> elements means the code looks crisp at any screen density.\n//\n// AESTHETICS:\n// This version supports \"Branded\" QR codes:\n// 1. Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = size / s
- izeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Render data modules as Dots (Circles)\n    return (\n      <Circle\n        key={`dot-${row}-${col}`}\n        cx={col * cellSize + cellSize / 2}\n        cy={row * cellSize + cellSize / 2}\n        r={cellSize / 2.3} // Slightly smaller than half for a \"dotted\" look\n        fill={color}\n      />\n    );\n  };\n\n  const renderEye = (x: number, y: number) => {\n    const eyeSize = 7 * cellSize;\n    const innerSize = 3 * cellSize;\n    const innerOffset = 2 * cellSize;\n\n    return (\n      <G x={x} y={y}>\n        {/* Outer Ring */}\n        <Rect\n          x={cellSize * 0.5}\n          y={cellSize * 0.5}\n          width={eyeSize - cellSize}\n          height={eyeSize - cellSize}\n          rx={cellSize * 1.5}\n          fill=\"none\"\n          stroke={color}\n          strokeWidth={cellSize}\n        />\n        {/* Inner Dot */}\n        <Rect\n          x={innerOffset + cellSize * 0.5}\n          y={innerOffset + cellSize * 0.5}\n          width={innerSize - cellSize}\n          height={innerSize - cellSize}\n          rx={cellSize * 0.75}\n          fill={color}\n        />\n      </G>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <View style={styles.outerContainer}>\n      {showFrame && (\n        <View style={[styles.frameLabel, { backgroundColor: color }]}>\n          <Text style={styles.frameLabelText}>{frameText.toUpperCase()}</Text>\n        </View>\n      )}\n\n      <View\n        style={[\n          styles.qrWrapper,\n          {\n            borderRadius,\n            padding,\n            backgroundColor,\n            borderColor: showFrame ? color : 'transparent',\n          },\n        ]}\n      >\n        <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>\n          {/* Background fill */}\n          <Rect x=\"0\" y=\"0\" width={size} height={size} fill={backgroundColor} />\n\n          {/* Render Eyes first */}\n          {renderEye(0, 0)}\n          {renderEye((sizeCells - 7) * cellSize, 0)}\n          {renderEye(0, (sizeCells - 7) * cellSize)}\n\n          {/* QR data modules */}\n          {[...matrix.data].map((cell, index) => {\n            const row = Math.floor(index / sizeCells);\n            const col = index % sizeCells;\n            return renderModule(cell, row, col);\n          })}\n\n          {/* Central Lotus Emoji */}\n          {showLotus && (\n            <SvgText\n              x={size / 2}\n              y={size / 2 + cellSize * 1.5} // Adjust for vertical alignment\n              fontSize={cellSize * (centerClearance - 1.5)}\n              textAnchor=\"middle\"\n            >\n              {'\\uD83E\\uDEB7'}\n            </SvgText>\n          )}\n        </Svg>\n      </View>\n\n      {label && <Text style={[styles.label, { color }]}>{label}</Text>}\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  outerContainer: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  qrWrapper: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n    borderWidth: 2,\n  },\n  container: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  label: {\n    marginTop: 12,\n    fontSize: 14,\n    fontWeight: '600',\n    textAlign: 'center',\n    letterSpacing: 0.5,\n  },\n  frameLabel: {\n    paddingHorizontal: 16,\n    paddingVertical: 4,\n    borderTopLeftRadius: 10,\n    borderTopRightRadius: 10,\n    marginBottom: -2, // Slight overlap\n    zIndex: 1,\n  },\n  frameLabelText: {\n    color: 'white',\n    fontSize: 10,\n    fontWeight: 'bold',\n    letterSpacing: 2,\n  },\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\ResonantHeatmap.tsx","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\SanctuaryBackground.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"react-hooks/refs","severity":1,"message":"Error: Cannot access refs during render\n\nReact refs are values that are not needed for rendering. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - just update immediately\n      prevNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n      currentNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n      fadeAnim.setValue(1);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Crossfade: prev layer stays, new layer fades in over 2s\n    prevNodes.current = currentNodes.current;\n    currentNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n\n    fadeAnim.setValue(0);\n    const animation = Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {\n      toValue: 1,\n      duration: 2000,\n      useNativeDriver: true,\n    });\n    animation.start();\n\n    return () => animation.stop();\n    // Note: isDark theme-mode toggles DO trigger a crossfade here to ensure immediate reactive update\n    // of the background gradient nodes.\n  }, [phase, isDark]); // Re-run when phase OR theme mode changes.\n\n  return (\n    <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} pointerEvents=\"none\">\n      {/* Layer 0: Previous phase (fades out) */}\n      <LinearGradient\n        colors={prevNodes.current}\n        start={{ x: 0.1, y: 0 }}\n        end={{ x: 0.9, y: 1 }}\n        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject}\n      />\n      {/* Layer 1: Current phase (fades in) */}\n      <Animated.View\n        style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, { opacity: fadeAnim }]}\n        pointerEvents=\"none\"\n      >\n        <LinearGradient\n          colors={currentNodes.current}\n          start={{ x: 0.2, y: 0 }}\n          end={{ x: 0.8, y: 1 }}\n          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject}\n        />\n      </Animated.View>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\SanctuaryButton.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. 'bg-phase-interactive';\n      case 'negative':\n        return 'bg-phase-danger';\n      case 'positive':\n        return 'bg-phase-reward';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-phase-accent';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getTextClass = () => {\n    if (variant === 'solid') {\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'primary':\n          return 'text-phase-text-on-accent';\n        case 'secondary':\n  return 'text-phase-text-on-accent';\n      }\n    }\n    switch (action) {\n      case 'primary':\n        return 'text-phase-accent';\n      case 'secondary':\n        return </SanctuaryButton>\n              )}\n            </VStack>\n          ) : null\n        }\n      >\n        {pendingRequest && (\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Box        className={\n                    trustCopy.label === 'Broken or unverified'\n                      ? (\n                <Text className=\"text-phase-accent text-[12px] mt-1 font-bold\">\n                  {pendingRequest.options.sourceBadge}\n                </Text>\n              ) : null}\n              {pendingRequest.overrideCount >= 2 && !pendingRequest.currentPreference ? (light)\n * - Dusk:      5 PM - 8 PM  (dark)\n * - Night:     8 PM - 4 AM  (dark, wraps midnight)\n */\nexport function getTemporalPhase(): TemporalPhase {\n  const hour = new Date().getHours();\n  if {\n      tier = 'high';\n    }\n\n    return { tier, memoryGB };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('Failed to detect device tier:', error);\n    return { tier: 'medium', memoryGB: 4 };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Detects network quality based on connection info\n */\nexport async function detectNetworkQuality(): Promise<NetworkQuality> {\n  try {\n    const netInfo = await NetInfo.fetch();\n\n     onPress();\n      }}\n      accessible={true}\n      accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel || title}\n      accessibilityHint={accessibilityHint || items-center\">\n          {value && <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary mr-1\">{value}</Text>}\n          <ChevronRight size={20} className=\"text-phase-muted\" />\n        </HStack>\n      </HStack>\n    </Pressable>\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Settings Section Header\n */\nfunction SectionHeader({ title, description }: { title: string; description?: string }) {\n  return (\n    <VStack } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, scene, text: themeText } = useTheme();\n\n  const {\n    themeMode,\n    setThemeMode,\n    temporalPhase,\n    fidelityLevel,\n    setFidelityLevel,\n    language,\n    setLanguage,\n    isVeilActive,\n    toggleVeil,\n    reality,\n    enableLivingTheme,\n    setEnableLivingTheme,\n  } = useEnvironment();\n  const { isDemoMode, setDemoMode, user } = const [showLanguageModal, setShowLanguageModal] = useState(false);\n\n  // Theme mode labels\n  const getThemeLabel = () => {\n    if (themeMode === 'system') return t('settings.theme.system');\n    if (themeMode === 'auto') return t('settings.theme.auto');\n    if (themeMode === 'light') return t('settings.theme.light');\n    return t('settings.theme.dark');\n  };\n\n  // Fidelity labels\n  const getFidelityLabel = () => {\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'auto') return t('settings.fidelity.auto');\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'low') return t('settings.fidelity.low');\n    return t('settings.fidelity.high');\n  };\n\n  // Language labels\n  const getLanguageLabel = () => {\n    if (language === 'en') return 'English';\n    if (language === 'si') return 'α╖âα╖Æα╢éα╖äα╢╜';\n    return 'α«ñα««α«┐α«┤α»ì';\n  };\n\n  // Temporal phase description\n  const getTemporalDescription = () => {\n    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(i18n.language, {\n      hour: 'numeric',\n      minute: '2-digit',\n    });\n    const phases = {\n      predawn: t('settings.temporal.predawn'),\n      dawn: t('settings.temporal.dawn'),\n      morning: t('settings.temporal.morning'),\n      afternoon: t('settings.temporal.afternoon'),\n      dusk: t('settings.temporal.dusk'),\n      night: t('settings.temporal.night'),\n    };\n    return `${phases[temporalPhase as keyof typeof phases]} ΓÇó ${time}`;\n  };\n\n  const handleThemeChange = (mode: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto') => {\n    setThemeMode(mode);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowThemeModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const accessibilityRole=\"switch\"\n              accessibilityLabel={t('settings.living_theme.title')}\n              accessibilityState={{ checked: enableLivingTheme }}\n            />\n {user?.public_profile !== false\n                    ? t('profile.privacy.public_on', 'Others can find and view your profile')\n                    : t('profile.privacy.public_off', 'Your profile is  </HStack>\n        </Box>\n        <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Eye size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title={t('profile.privacy.previewProfile', 'See how others see you')}\n          description={t('profile.privacy.preview_desc', 'View your own public profile card')}\n          onPress={() => {\n            hapticLight();\n            navigation.navigate('Community', {\n              screen: 'UserProfile',\n              params: {\n                userId: user?.id,\n                userName: user?.full_name,\n              },\n {/* Device Info Section */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('settings.device.title')}\n          description={t('settings.device.description')}\n        />\n        <Box   <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary\">{t('settings.device.tier')}</Text>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-primary font-semibold\">\n                {reality.deviceTier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + reality.deviceTier.slice(1)}\n              </Text>\n            </HStack>\n            <HStack className=\"justify-between items-center\">\n {t('settings.tip.message')}\n              </Text>\n            </VStack>\n          </HStack>\n        </Box>\n      </ScrollView>\n\n      {/* Fidelity Selection Modal */}\n      {showFidelityModal },\n            {\n              id: 'low',\n              label: t('settings.fidelity.low'),\n              description: t('settings.fidelity.low_full'),\n              icon: <Smartphone size={24} useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport {\n  Box,\n  VStack,\n  Input,\n  InputField,\n  Button,\n  ButtonText,\n  Text,\n  Heading,\n  Center,\n  HStack,\n  Pressable,\n  Divider,\n  Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n ({\n    step,\n    title,\n    subtitle,\n    children,\n  }: {\n    step: string;\n    title: string;\n    subtitle: string;\n    children: React.ReactNode;\n  }) => (\n    <VStack className=\"flex-1 shadowViolet\n          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 14 },\n          shadowOpacity: 0.1,\n          shadowRadius: 24,\n        }}\n      >\n        <Box className=\"px-6 py-6 bg-phase-surface border-b border-phase-border\">\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap\">\n              {JOURNEY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-phase-canvas border border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-xs text-phase-text-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n            <ProgressIndicator currentStep={currentStep} totalSteps={TOTAL_STEPS} />\n            <VStack className=\"gap-1\">\n              <Text className=\"text-xs text-phase-accent font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                {step}\n              </Text>\n              <Heading size=\"2xl\" className=\"text-phase-text-primary\">\n                {title}\n              </Heading>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary\">{subtitle}</Text>\n            </VStack>\n          </VStack>\n        </Box>\n        <Box className=\"px-6 py-8\">{children}</Box>\n      </Box>\n    </VStack>\n  );\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Restore saved progress or pre-fill from existing auth ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    const initOnboarding = async () => {\n      const     if (saved) {\n          const progress = JSON.parse(saved);\n          if (!internalId || progress.userId === internalId) {\n            if (progress.name) setName(progress.name);\n            if (progress.role) setRole(progress.role as Role);\n            if (typeof progress.step === 'number' && progress.step >= 0 && progress.step < 7) {\n              setCurrentStep(progress.step);\n              return;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {\n        /* ignore corrupt storage */\n      }\n\n      // No saved progress ΓÇö pre-fill for verified (non-anonymous) users with a       console.log('≡ƒº¡ OnboardingScreen: No internalId found, initiating anonymous session...');\n        await authAPI.signInAnonymously();\n        // Re-run the initialization once signed in\n        return initOnboarding();\n      }\n      const { data: profile } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('full_name, is_anonymous, role, onboarding_completed')\n        .eq('id', name,\n          role,\n        }),\n      ).catch(() => {\n        /* silent */\n      });\n    });\n  }, [currentStep, name, role]);\n\n  const handleNext = async () => {\n    if (!canProceed) handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if (!internalId)\n        throw new Error('Failed to resolve internal user ID during onboarding completion');\n\n      hapticSuccess();\n\n      // Check if user already exists in public.users to avoid overwriting critical data\n      const { data: existingProfile } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('school_id')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .single();\n\n      // 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". The app will render the \\\"Guest Gate\\\"\n          // (Join/Create Workspace) as a fallback, which is a stable state.\n        } else {\n          schoolId = schoolData?.id;\n          console.log('Γ£à [Onboarding] Personal workspace created:', schoolId);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 2. Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. 'border-phase-accent bg-phase-accent/10' : 'border-phase-border bg-phase-secondary'}\n                            `}\n            >\n              <Text className=\"text-2xl mr-3\">{r.emoji}</Text>\n              <VStack className=\"flex-1\">\n                <Text\n                  className={`text-md font-bold ${selected ? justify-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-xs text-phase-text-on-accent\">Γ£ô</Text>\n                </Box>\n              )}\n            </Pressable>\n          );\n        })}\n      </VStack>\n      <HStack className=\"gap-4 mt-6\">\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" onPress={handleBack} className=\"flex-1 border-phase-border\">\n          <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-on-accent font-bold\">\n            {t('onboarding.continue')}\n          </ButtonText>\n        </Button>\n      </HStack>\n    </VStack>\n  );\n\n  const renderTourStep = {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button </Button>\n            <Button onPress={handleNext} className=\"bg-phase-accent flex-[2]\">\n              <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-on-accent font-bold\">\n                {index === 6 ? t('onboarding.finish') : t('onboarding.next')}\n              </ButtonText>\n            </Button>\n          </HStack>\n          <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={handleSkipTour}>\n Auditor\n *\n * Scans Theme.ts and phaseMatrix for contrast violations using APCA and WCAG 2.1.\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/audit-theme.ts\n */\n\nimport { colors, phaseMatrix, resolvePhaseTokens } from '../src/theme/Theme';\nimport { checkAccessibility, toHex } from '../src/utils/a11yUtils';\nimport { TemporalPhase } from '../src/context/types';\n\nconst PHASES: TemporalPhase[] = ['predawn', 'dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'dusk', 'night'];\nconst MODES: ('light' | 'dark')[] = ['light', 'dark'];\n\nconsole.log('\\x1b[36m%s\\x1b[0m', '--- GURUDEVI THEME ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT ---');\nconsole.log('Validating Sanctuary tokens against WCAG 2.1 and APCA Standards...\\n');\n\nlet violations = 0;\nlet totalChecks = 0;\n\nfunction report(\n  label: string,\n  fg: string,\n  bg: string,\n  requirement: { wcag?: number; apca?: number },\n) {\n  totalChecks++;\n  const fgHex = toHex(fg);\n  const bgHex = toHex(bg);\n  const { ratio, apca, apcaRating } = checkAccessibility(fgHex, bgHex);\n\n  let failed = false;\n  const details = [];\n\n  if (requirement.wcag && ratio < requirement.wcag) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`WCAG: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 (Min ${requirement.wcag})`);\n  }\n\n  if (requirement.apca && Math.abs(apca) < requirement.apca) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`APCA: ${apca.toFixed(1)} Lc (Min ${requirement.apca} - ${apcaRating})`);\n  }\n\n  if (failed) {\n    violations++;\n    console.log(`\\x1b[31m[FAIL]\\x1b[0m ${label}`);\n    console.log(`       - BG: ${bgHex}, FG: ${fgHex}`);\n    console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n  console.log(`\\x1b[32mSUCCESS: All ${totalChecks} checks passed.\\x1b[0m`);\n  process.exit(0);\n} else {\n  console.log(\n    `\\x1b[31mWARNING: Found ${violations} accessibility violations across       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const await accountPin.verifyPin(account.accountId, values.pin);\n        if (!ok) {\n          throw new Error('PIN did not match this account.');\n        }\n        await const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = size / s
- izeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - Philosophy: Simple, reusable foundation for UI cards\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Pressable, Platform } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, { useSharedValue, TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface SanctuaryCardProps {\n  title?: string;\n  children: any;\n  footer?: any;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  onLongPress?: () => void;\n  href?: string;\n  target?: '_blank' | '_self';\n  elevated?: boolean;\n  style?: any;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL = 1.0;\nconst LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED = 1.02;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst SanctuaryCard: FC<SanctuaryCardProps> = ({\n  title,\n  children,\n  footer,\n  onPress,\n  onLongPress,\n  href,\n  target = '_self',\n  elevated = false,\n  style,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  // Hover state - only meaningful on web (desktop pointer devices)\n  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);\n\n  // Shared value for lift animation\n  const scale = useSharedValue(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION: LIFT EFFECT (when pressable)\n  // });\n\n  const handlePressIn = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePressOut = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // RENDER: Container Level\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const overflow-hidden\n                ${elevated ? 'shadow-xl shadow-black/20' : ''}\n                ${hovered && Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'opacity-90 scale-[1.01]' : ''}\n                ${className || ''}\n            `}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"p-6\">\n        {/* Title Section */}\n        {title && <Text className=\"text-xl font-bold text-phase-text-primary mb-4\">{title}</Text>}\n\n        {/* Children Content */}\n        <Box className=\"gap-4\">{children}</Box>\n\n        {/* Footer Section */}\n        {footer && (\n          <VStack className=\"mt-4 gap-4\">\n            <Box className=\"h-px bg-white/5 opacity-30\" />\n            {footer}\n          </VStack>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress || href) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable\n        onPress={onPress}\n        onLongPress={onLongPress}\n        onPressIn={handlePressIn}\n        onPressOut={handlePressOut}\n        onHoverIn={Platform.OS === 'web' ? Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      const apiError = handleAPIError(error);\n      showToast({\n        message:\n          typeof apiError === 'string'\n            ? apiError\n            : (apiError as any).message || 'An authentication error occurred',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper scroll>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 px-6 py-8\">\n        <SanctuaryBackground />\n        <VStack className=\"w-full max-w-[460px] self-center gap-6\">\n          {onBack && (\n            <Box className=\"self-start\">\n              <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={onBack} className=\"pl-0\">\n                <HStack className=\"gap-1 items-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-lg\">ΓåÉ</Text>\n                  <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">Back</ButtonText>\n                </HStack>\n              </Button>\n            </Box>\n          )}\n\n          <VStack className=\"gap-5 items-center pt-4\">\n            <BreathAnimation delay={100}>\n              <LivingGlow\n                active\n                size={132}\n                style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}\n              >\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n                  <Box\n                    className=\"px-4 py-1 rounded-full border\"\n                    style={{\n                      backgroundColor: `${accent.action}12`,\n                      borderColor: `${accent.action}28`,\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Text\n                      className=\"text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.5px]\"\n                      style={{ color: accent.action }}\n                    >\n                      ENTER THE SANCTUARY\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                  <Heading\n                    size=\"3xl\"\n                    className=\"text-center font-bold tracking-[-1.2px]\"\n                    style={{ color: text.primary }}\n                  >\n                    Gurudevi\n                  </Heading>\n                </VStack>\n              </LivingGlow>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <BreathAnimation delay={200}>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-center max-w-[320px]\">\n                {t('auth.tagline') || 'Enter the Sanctuary of Learning'}\n              </Text>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap justify-center\">\n              {ENTRY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-phase-surface border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n          </VStack>\n\n          <Box\n            className=\"p-0 overflow-hidden border-t-4 bg-phase-surface border-phase-border rounded-3xl\"\n            style={{ borderTopColor: accent.action }}\n          >\n            <VStack className=\"gap-6 p-6\">\n              <Box className=\"p-5 rounded-2xl bg-phase-surface/40 border border-phase-border\">\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-muted font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                    SANCTUARY ENTRY\n                  </Text>\n                  <Heading size=\"sm\" className=\"text-phase-primary\">\n                    {isSignUp ? 'Begin with a held identity' : 'Return to your learning sanctuary'}\n                  </Heading>\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">\n                    {isSignUp\n                      ? handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-tertiary\">{t('onboarding.skip')}</ButtonText>\n          </Button>\n        </VStack>\n      </VStack>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper>\n Auditor\n *\n * Scans Theme.ts and phaseMatrix for contrast violations using APCA and WCAG 2.1.\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/audit-theme.ts\n */\n\nimport { colors, phaseMatrix, resolvePhaseTokens } from '../src/theme/Theme';\nimport { checkAccessibility, toHex } from '../src/utils/a11yUtils';\nimport { TemporalPhase } from '../src/context/types';\n\nconst PHASES: TemporalPhase[] = ['predawn', 'dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'dusk', 'night'];\nconst MODES: ('light' | 'dark')[] = ['light', 'dark'];\n\nconsole.log('\\x1b[36m%s\\x1b[0m', '--- GURUDEVI THEME ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT ---');\nconsole.log('Validating Sanctuary tokens against WCAG 2.1 and APCA Standards...\\n');\n\nlet violations = 0;\nlet totalChecks = 0;\n\nfunction report(\n  label: string,\n  fg: string,\n  bg: string,\n  requirement: { wcag?: number; apca?: number },\n) {\n  totalChecks++;\n  const fgHex = toHex(fg);\n  const bgHex = toHex(bg);\n  const { ratio, apca, apcaRating } = checkAccessibility(fgHex, bgHex);\n\n  let failed = false;\n  const details = [];\n\n  if (requirement.wcag && ratio < requirement.wcag) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`WCAG: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 (Min ${requirement.wcag})`);\n  }\n\n  if (requirement.apca && Math.abs(apca) < requirement.apca) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`APCA: ${apca.toFixed(1)} Lc (Min ${requirement.apca} - ${apcaRating})`);\n  }\n\n  if (failed) {\n    violations++;\n    console.log(`\\x1b[31m[FAIL]\\x1b[0m ${label}`);\n    console.log(`       - BG: ${bgHex}, FG: ${fgHex}`);\n    console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n  console.log(`\\x1b[32mSUCCESS: All ${totalChecks} checks passed.\\x1b[0m`);\n  process.exit(0);\n} else {\n  console.log(\n    `\\x1b[31mWARNING: Found ${violations} accessibility violations across ${totalChecks} checks.\\x1b[0m`,\n  );\n  // We don't exit with 1 yet to avoid breaking builds until we fix the colors\n void;\n  icon?: React.ReactNode;\n  actions?: ActionItem[];\n  scrollY?: SharedValue<number>;\n  disabled?: boolean;\n  bottomInset?: number; // New prop for safe area handling\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst FAB_SIZE = 72; // Slightly larger for the art\nconst FAB_HIT_SLOP = 10;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SIZE = 48;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING = 12;\nconst LONG_PRESS_DURATION = 400; // milliseconds\nconst SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;\n\n// Context-aware configuration\ntype IconComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n\nconst fabConfig:       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const await accountPin.verifyPin(account.accountId, values.pin);\n        if (!ok) {\n          throw new Error('PIN did not match this account.');\n        }\n        await const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = size / s
- izeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - Philosophy: Simple, reusable foundation for UI cards\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Pressable, Platform } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, { useSharedValue,
