TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface SanctuaryCardProps {\n  title?: string;\n  children: any;\n  footer?: any;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  onLongPress?: () => void;\n  href?: string;\n  target?: '_blank' | '_self';\n  elevated?: boolean;\n  style?: any;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL = 1.0;\nconst LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED = 1.02;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst SanctuaryCard: FC<SanctuaryCardProps> = ({\n  title,\n  children,\n  footer,\n  onPress,\n  onLongPress,\n  href,\n  target = '_self',\n  elevated = false,\n  style,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  // Hover state - only meaningful on web (desktop pointer devices)\n  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);\n\n  // Shared value for lift animation\n  const scale = useSharedValue(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION: LIFT EFFECT (when pressable)\n  // });\n\n  const handlePressIn = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePressOut = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // RENDER: Container Level\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const overflow-hidden\n                ${elevated ? 'shadow-xl shadow-black/20' : ''}\n                ${hovered && Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'opacity-90 scale-[1.01]' : ''}\n                ${className || ''}\n            `}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"p-6\">\n        {/* Title Section */}\n        {title && <Text className=\"text-xl font-bold text-phase-text-primary mb-4\">{title}</Text>}\n\n        {/* Children Content */}\n        <Box className=\"gap-4\">{children}</Box>\n\n        {/* Footer Section */}\n        {footer && (\n          <VStack className=\"mt-4 gap-4\">\n            <Box className=\"h-px bg-white/5 opacity-30\" />\n            {footer}\n          </VStack>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress || href) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable\n        onPress={onPress}\n        onLongPress={onLongPress}\n        onPressIn={handlePressIn}\n        onPressOut={handlePressOut}\n        onHoverIn={Platform.OS === 'web' ? Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      const apiError = handleAPIError(error);\n      showToast({\n        message:\n          typeof apiError === 'string'\n            ? apiError\n            : (apiError as any).message || 'An authentication error occurred',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper scroll>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 px-6 py-8\">\n        <SanctuaryBackground />\n        <VStack className=\"w-full max-w-[460px] self-center gap-6\">\n          {onBack && (\n            <Box className=\"self-start\">\n              <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={onBack} className=\"pl-0\">\n                <HStack className=\"gap-1 items-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-lg\">ΓåÉ</Text>\n                  <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">Back</ButtonText>\n                </HStack>\n              </Button>\n            </Box>\n          )}\n\n          <VStack className=\"gap-5 items-center pt-4\">\n            <BreathAnimation delay={100}>\n              <LivingGlow\n                active\n                size={132}\n                style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}\n              >\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n                  <Box\n                    className=\"px-4 py-1 rounded-full border\"\n                    style={{\n                      backgroundColor: `${accent.action}12`,\n                      borderColor: `${accent.action}28`,\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Text\n                      className=\"text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.5px]\"\n                      style={{ color: accent.action }}\n                    >\n                      ENTER THE SANCTUARY\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                  <Heading\n                    size=\"3xl\"\n                    className=\"text-center font-bold tracking-[-1.2px]\"\n                    style={{ color: text.primary }}\n                  >\n                    Gurudevi\n                  </Heading>\n                </VStack>\n              </LivingGlow>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <BreathAnimation delay={200}>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-center max-w-[320px]\">\n                {t('auth.tagline') || 'Enter the Sanctuary of Learning'}\n              </Text>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap justify-center\">\n              {ENTRY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-phase-surface border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n          </VStack>\n\n          <Box\n            className=\"p-0 overflow-hidden border-t-4 bg-phase-surface border-phase-border rounded-3xl\"\n            style={{ borderTopColor: accent.action }}\n          >\n            <VStack className=\"gap-6 p-6\">\n              <Box className=\"p-5 rounded-2xl bg-phase-surface/40 border border-phase-border\">\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-muted font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                    SANCTUARY ENTRY\n                  </Text>\n                  <Heading size=\"sm\" className=\"text-phase-primary\">\n                    {isSignUp ? 'Begin with a held identity' : 'Return to your learning sanctuary'}\n                  </Heading>\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">\n                    {isSignUp\n                      ? handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-tertiary\">{t('onboarding.skip')}</ButtonText>\n          </Button>\n        </VStack>\n      </VStack>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper>\n Auditor\n *\n * Scans Theme.ts and phaseMatrix for contrast violations using APCA and WCAG 2.1.\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/audit-theme.ts\n */\n\nimport { colors, phaseMatrix, resolvePhaseTokens } from '../src/theme/Theme';\nimport { checkAccessibility, toHex } from '../src/utils/a11yUtils';\nimport { TemporalPhase } from '../src/context/types';\n\nconst PHASES: TemporalPhase[] = ['predawn', 'dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'dusk', 'night'];\nconst MODES: ('light' | 'dark')[] = ['light', 'dark'];\n\nconsole.log('\\x1b[36m%s\\x1b[0m', '--- GURUDEVI THEME ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT ---');\nconsole.log('Validating Sanctuary tokens against WCAG 2.1 and APCA Standards...\\n');\n\nlet violations = 0;\nlet totalChecks = 0;\n\nfunction report(\n  label: string,\n  fg: string,\n  bg: string,\n  requirement: { wcag?: number; apca?: number },\n) {\n  totalChecks++;\n  const fgHex = toHex(fg);\n  const bgHex = toHex(bg);\n  const { ratio, apca, apcaRating } = checkAccessibility(fgHex, bgHex);\n\n  let failed = false;\n  const details = [];\n\n  if (requirement.wcag && ratio < requirement.wcag) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`WCAG: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 (Min ${requirement.wcag})`);\n  }\n\n  if (requirement.apca && Math.abs(apca) < requirement.apca) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`APCA: ${apca.toFixed(1)} Lc (Min ${requirement.apca} - ${apcaRating})`);\n  }\n\n  if (failed) {\n    violations++;\n    console.log(`\\x1b[31m[FAIL]\\x1b[0m ${label}`);\n    console.log(`       - BG: ${bgHex}, FG: ${fgHex}`);\n    console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n  console.log(`\\x1b[32mSUCCESS: All ${totalChecks} checks passed.\\x1b[0m`);\n  process.exit(0);\n} else {\n  console.log(\n    `\\x1b[31mWARNING: Found ${violations} accessibility violations across ${totalChecks} checks.\\x1b[0m`,\n  );\n  // We don't exit with 1 yet to avoid breaking builds until we fix the colors\n void;\n  icon?: React.ReactNode;\n  actions?: ActionItem[];\n  scrollY?: SharedValue<number>;\n  disabled?: boolean;\n  bottomInset?: number; // New prop for safe area handling\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst FAB_SIZE = 72; // Slightly larger for the art\nconst FAB_HIT_SLOP = 10;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SIZE = 48;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING = 12;\nconst LONG_PRESS_DURATION = 400; // milliseconds\nconst SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;\n\n// Context-aware configuration\ntype IconComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n\nconst fabConfig:       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const await accountPin.verifyPin(account.accountId, values.pin);\n        if (!ok) {\n          throw new Error('PIN did not match this account.');\n        }\n        await const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = size / s
- izeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - Philosophy: Simple, reusable foundation for UI cards\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Pressable, Platform } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, { useSharedValue, TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface SanctuaryCardProps {\n  title?: string;\n  children: any;\n  footer?: any;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  onLongPress?: () => void;\n  href?: string;\n  target?: '_blank' | '_self';\n  elevated?: boolean;\n  style?: any;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL = 1.0;\nconst LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED = 1.02;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst SanctuaryCard: FC<SanctuaryCardProps> = ({\n  title,\n  children,\n  footer,\n  onPress,\n  onLongPress,\n  href,\n  target = '_self',\n  elevated = false,\n  style,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  // Hover state - only meaningful on web (desktop pointer devices)\n  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);\n\n  // Shared value for lift animation\n  const scale = useSharedValue(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION: LIFT EFFECT (when pressable)\n  // });\n\n  const handlePressIn = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePressOut = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // RENDER: Container Level\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const overflow-hidden\n                ${elevated ? 'shadow-xl shadow-black/20' : ''}\n                ${hovered && Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'opacity-90 scale-[1.01]' : ''}\n                ${className || ''}\n            `}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"p-6\">\n        {/* Title Section */}\n        {title && <Text className=\"text-xl font-bold text-phase-text-primary mb-4\">{title}</Text>}\n\n        {/* Children Content */}\n        <Box className=\"gap-4\">{children}</Box>\n\n        {/* Footer Section */}\n        {footer && (\n          <VStack className=\"mt-4 gap-4\">\n            <Box className=\"h-px bg-white/5 opacity-30\" />\n            {footer}\n          </VStack>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress || href) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable\n        onPress={onPress}\n        onLongPress={onLongPress}\n        onPressIn={handlePressIn}\n        onPressOut={handlePressOut}\n        onHoverIn={Platform.OS === 'web' ? Spinner,\n  InputSlot,\n  InputIcon,\n  ButtonSpinner,\n} from '../gluestack';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess, hapticError } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { default as GuestDataSyncModal } from '../components/GuestDataSyncModal';\nimport { Mail, Eye, EyeOff, Chrome } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Platform, type TextInput } from 'react-native';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { BreathAnimation } from '../components/BreathAnimation';\nimport { LivingGlow } from '../components/LivingGlow';\nimport { SanctuaryBackground } from '../components/SanctuaryBackground';\nimport { Role, handleAPIError, validators, validateForm } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { supabase, GuestDataSync, identityAPI, authAPI, FlowResolver } from '@repo/core/native';\nimport AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';\nimport * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';\nimport * as AuthSession from 'expo-auth-session';\n\n// Required for expo-auth-session to complete the auth session on Android\n// (handles the Chrome Custom Tab callback redirect)\nWebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();\n\n// Google 'G' icon rendered with plain RN ΓÇö no react-native-svg needed\nconst GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }: { size?: number }) => (\n  <Box\n    style={{\n      width: size,\n      height: size,\n      borderRadius: size / 2,\n      backgroundColor: '#fff',\n      alignItems: 'center',\n      justifyContent: 'center',\n    }}\n  >\n    <Text\n      style={{\n        fontSize: size * 0.65,\n        fontWeight: '700',\n        color: '#4285F4',\n        lineHeight: size * 0.75,\n      }}\n    >\n      G\n    </Text>\n  </Box>\n);\n\nconst ENTRY_PILLARS = ['Self', 'Classroom', 'Community', 'Library'];\n\ninterface AuthScreenProps {\n  onSuccess?: () => void;\n  onBack?: () => void;\n  /** Start the auth screen in login mode (vs default sign-up) */\n  initialMode?: 'login' | 'signup';\n  /** Injected Scanner component to avoid circular dependencies with @repo/scanner-kit */\n  Scanner?: React.ComponentType<{\n    visible: boolean;\n    onClose: () => void;\n    onScan: (data: string) => Promise<void>;\n    title?: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nexport default function AuthScreen({ onSuccess, onBack, initialMode, Scanner }: AuthScreenProps) {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, text, glow } = useTheme();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [showEmailAuth, setShowEmailAuth] = useState(initialMode === 'login');\n  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(initialMode !== 'login');\n  const [showScanner, setShowScanner] = useState(false);\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [showSyncModal, setShowSyncModal] = useState(false);\n  const [newUserId, setNewUserId] = useState<string>('');\n  const syncCheckDoneRef = useRef(false);\n  const passwordRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);\n\n  // Load current user from public.users via the internal identity (new architecture pattern).\n  // This gives us email + is_anonymous from our own DB, not raw Supabase auth.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    identityAPI.getMyInternalId().then(async (internalId) => {\n      if (!internalId) {\n        setCurrentUser(null);\n        return;\n      }\n      const { data } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, email, is_anonymous, full_name')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      if (data) setCurrentUser(data);\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Browser callback handling ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  // For web and mobile (via redirected app protocols), we check the URL for tokens\n  // which signifies a successful OAuth return.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    // Only run on web to avoid conflicts with deep linking handlers in Expo go\n    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;\n\n    const hashParams = new URL(window.location.href.replace('#', '?')).searchParams;\n    const getUrlParam = (name: string) => {\n      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);\n      if (search.has(name)) return search.get(name);\n      const hashSearch = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));\n      return hashSearch.get(name);\n    };\n    const errorCode = getUrlParam('error_code');\n    const errorDesc = getUrlParam('error_description');\n    if (!errorCode) return;\n\n    if (errorCode === 'identity_already_exists') {\n      // Switch to login tab and show a helpful message\n      setIsSignUp(false);\n      setShowEmailAuth(true);\n      // Decode and surface the message after a short delay so AuthScreen has mounted\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.identityAlreadyExists') ||\n            'This account already exists. Please sign in instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      // Clean the error params from the URL without triggering a reload\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    } else if (errorCode) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        showToast({\n          message: decodeURIComponent(errorDesc ?? errorCode).replace(/\\+/g, ' '),\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      }, 300);\n      try {\n        const cleanUrl = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;\n        window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanUrl);\n      } catch (_) {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const isRealUser = currentUser && currentUser.email && !currentUser.is_anonymous;\n  const shouldHideGeneralAuth = isRealUser;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Native redirect URI (used by expo-auth-session) ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n  const getRedirectUrl = () => {\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      return window.location.origin;\n    }\n    return AuthSession.makeRedirectUri({\n      scheme: 'gurudevi',\n      path: 'auth/callback',\n    });\n  };\n\n  async function handleOAuthSignIn(provider: 'google') {\n    setLoading(true);\n    hapticLight();\n\n    const redirectUrl = getRedirectUrl();\n    const session = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n    const isAnon = session?.user?.is_anonymous || !session?.user?.email;\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Web platform: classic browser-redirect flow ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      if (isAnon && session?.user) {\n        const { error } = await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n          provider,\n          options: { redirectTo: redirectUrl },\n        });\n        if (error) {\n          if (error.message.includes('already linked')) {\n            showToast({\n              message:\n                t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n                'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n              type: 'error',\n            });\n          } else {\n            handleAPIError(error);\n          }\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider,\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n          queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (error) {\n        handleAPIError(error);\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // ΓöÇΓöÇ Native platform: use expo-auth-session ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n    const oauthOptions =\n      isAnon && session?.user\n        ? await supabase.auth.linkIdentity({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          })\n        : await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n            provider,\n            options: {\n              redirectTo: redirectUrl,\n              skipBrowserRedirect: true,\n              queryParams: { prompt: 'select_account' },\n            },\n          });\n\n    const oauthError = oauthOptions.error;\n    const oauthUrl = (oauthOptions.data as any)?.url as string | null | undefined;\n\n    if (oauthError) {\n      if (oauthError.message.includes('already linked')) {\n        showToast({\n          message:\n            t('auth.alreadyLinked') ||\n            'This Google account is already linked to another sanctuary soul. Please login instead.',\n          type: 'error',\n        });\n      } else {\n        handleAPIError(oauthError);\n      }\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!oauthUrl) {\n      showToast({\n        message: 'Could not reach Google sign-in. Please try again.',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n      setLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const authResponse = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(oauthUrl, redirectUrl);\n\n    if (authResponse.type === 'success' && (authResponse as any).url) {\n      const url = new URL((authResponse as any).url);\n      const params = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());\n      const access_token = params.access_token || url.hash.match(/access_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      const refresh_token = params.refresh_token || url.hash.match(/refresh_token=([^&]+)/)?.[1];\n      if (!access_token || !refresh_token) {\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const { error: sessErr } = await supabase.auth.setSession({\n        access_token,\n        refresh_token,\n      });\n\n      if (sessErr) {\n        handleAPIError(sessErr);\n      } else {\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const userId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (userId) {\n          const internalId = userId;\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite && internalId) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({\n                  message: 'Welcome to your new school sanctuary!',\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n        if (isAnon && hasGuestData && userId) {\n          setNewUserId(userId);\n          setShowSyncModal(true);\n        } else {\n          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    setLoading(false);\n  }\n\n  async function handleAuth() {\n    const { isValid, errors: valErrors } = validateForm(\n      { email, password },\n      {\n        email: validators.email,\n        password: (val: string) => validators.nonEmpty(val, 'Password'),\n      },\n    );\n\n    if (!isValid) {\n      setErrors(valErrors);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      if (isSignUp) {\n        const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n        const isAnon = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous || !currentSession?.user?.email;\n\n        if (isAnon && currentSession?.user) {\n          const existingName =\n            (currentUser?.full_name && String(currentUser.full_name).trim()) || 'Sanctuary User';\n          await authAPI.linkAnonymousToEmail(email, password, existingName, 'teacher' as Role);\n\n          const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.signupSuccess'), type: 'success' });\n\n          // Check for guest data to sync\n          const hasGuestData = await GuestDataSync.hasGuestData();\n          if (hasGuestData && internalId) {\n            setNewUserId(internalId);\n            setShowSyncModal(true);\n          } else {\n            if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n          }\n        } else {\n          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({\n            email,\n            password,\n          });\n          if (error) {\n            if (\n              error.message.includes('already registered') ||\n              error.message.includes('Email already in use') ||\n              (error as any).status === 422\n            ) {\n              showToast({\n                message:\n                  t('auth.alreadyRegistered') ||\n                  'You already have a sanctuary soul! Switching to login...',\n                type: 'success',\n              });\n              setIsSignUp(false);\n              setLoading(false);\n              return;\n            }\n            throw error;\n          }\n          hapticSuccess();\n          showToast({ message: t('auth.checkEmail'), type: 'success' });\n        }\n      } else {\n        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n        if (error) throw error;\n\n        hapticSuccess();\n        const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n        if (internalId) {\n          const pendingInvite = await AsyncStorage.getItem('pending_invite');\n          if (pendingInvite) {\n            try {\n              const invite = JSON.parse(pendingInvite);\n              if (invite.school_id) {\n                await supabase\n                  .from('users')\n                  .update({ school_id: invite.school_id, role: (invite.role as Role) || 'teacher' })\n                  .eq('id', internalId);\n                await AsyncStorage.removeItem('pending_invite');\n                showToast({ message: 'Reconnected to your school sanctuary!', type: 'success' });\n              }\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.error('Failed to apply pending invite', e);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (onSuccess) onSuccess();\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      const apiError = handleAPIError(error);\n      showToast({\n        message:\n          typeof apiError === 'string'\n            ? apiError\n            : (apiError as any).message || 'An authentication error occurred',\n        type: 'error',\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper scroll>\n      <Box className=\"flex-1 px-6 py-8\">\n        <SanctuaryBackground />\n        <VStack className=\"w-full max-w-[460px] self-center gap-6\">\n          {onBack && (\n            <Box className=\"self-start\">\n              <Button variant=\"ghost\" onPress={onBack} className=\"pl-0\">\n                <HStack className=\"gap-1 items-center\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-lg\">ΓåÉ</Text>\n                  <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">Back</ButtonText>\n                </HStack>\n              </Button>\n            </Box>\n          )}\n\n          <VStack className=\"gap-5 items-center pt-4\">\n            <BreathAnimation delay={100}>\n              <LivingGlow\n                active\n                size={132}\n                style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}\n              >\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n                  <Box\n                    className=\"px-4 py-1 rounded-full border\"\n                    style={{\n                      backgroundColor: `${accent.action}12`,\n                      borderColor: `${accent.action}28`,\n                    }}\n                  >\n                    <Text\n                      className=\"text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.5px]\"\n                      style={{ color: accent.action }}\n                    >\n                      ENTER THE SANCTUARY\n                    </Text>\n                  </Box>\n                  <Heading\n                    size=\"3xl\"\n                    className=\"text-center font-bold tracking-[-1.2px]\"\n                    style={{ color: text.primary }}\n                  >\n                    Gurudevi\n                  </Heading>\n                </VStack>\n              </LivingGlow>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <BreathAnimation delay={200}>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-center max-w-[320px]\">\n                {t('auth.tagline') || 'Enter the Sanctuary of Learning'}\n              </Text>\n            </BreathAnimation>\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap justify-center\">\n              {ENTRY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-phase-surface border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n          </VStack>\n\n          <Box\n            className=\"p-0 overflow-hidden border-t-4 bg-phase-surface border-phase-border rounded-3xl\"\n            style={{ borderTopColor: accent.action }}\n          >\n            <VStack className=\"gap-6 p-6\">\n              <Box className=\"p-5 rounded-2xl bg-phase-surface/40 border border-phase-border\">\n                <VStack className=\"gap-2\">\n                  <Text className=\"text-[10px] text-phase-muted font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                    SANCTUARY ENTRY\n                  </Text>\n                  <Heading size=\"sm\" className=\"text-phase-primary\">\n                    {isSignUp ? 'Begin with a held identity' : 'Return to your learning sanctuary'}\n                  </Heading>\n                  <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary text-sm\">\n                    {isSignUp\n                      ? handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if 1. Create a default school (Personal Workspace) only if they don't have one\n      let schoolId = existingProfile?.school_id;\n      if (!schoolId) {\n        const schoolName = `${name || 'My'}'s Workspace`;\n\n        // Note: The schools table currently has a broken trigger referencing\n        // \\\"create_personal_workspace_unified()\\\". Update user profile\n      const currentSession = await authAPI.getSession().catch(() => null);\n      const actuallyAnonymous = currentSession?.user?.is_anonymous ?? true;\n\n      const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('users').upsert({\n        id: internalId,\n        full_name: name || 'Gurudevi User',\n        role: role,\n        school_id: schoolId,\n        onboarding_completed: true,\n        onboarding_completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        is_anonymous: actuallyAnonymous,\n      });\n\n      if (profileError) {\n        console.error('Γ¥î Onboarding: Profile upsert failed:', profileError.message);\n        throw profileError;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Γ£à Onboarding: Profile successfully synced to DB.');\n\n      await AsyncStorage.removeItem('onboarding_progress');\n      onComplete(name, role, false);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error completing onboarding:', error);\n      hapticError();\n      setIsCompleting(false);\n      toast.showToast({ message: 'Failed to save profile. {screen.content}\n            </Text>\n          </Box>\n        </VStack>\n        <VStack className=\"gap-4 mt-auto pb-6\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Button <ButtonText className=\"text-phase-text-tertiary\">{t('onboarding.skip')}</ButtonText>\n          </Button>\n        </VStack>\n      </VStack>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <ScreenWrapper>\n useStore } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { api } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { hapticSuccess, hapticWarning } from '../utils/haptics';\n\n/**\n * Hook to handle the \"Bridge to Reality\" flow when exiting Demo Mode.\n * If the user has performed any simulated writes, it prompts them to save.\n */\nexport function useDemoBridge() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => log.method.startsWith('create') || log.method.startsWith('add'),\n    );\n    const firstItemName =\n      (firstLog?.payload as any)?.name || (firstLog?.payload as any)?.title || 'item';\n\n    hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // Bridge the data to reality\n              await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n\n              hapticSuccess();\n            } finally {\n              setBridging(false);\n              clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule = (api as any)[log.module];\n        if (apiModule && typeof apiModule[log.method] === 'function') {\n          // Execute the REAL API call (no proxy interception because we'll be in production mode or we force it)\n          // Note: Since isDemoMode is still true during this loop,\n          // we need to make sure the proxy doesn't intercept these \"bridging\" calls.\n          // A simple way is to pass a special flag in args or rely on the fact that\n          // we'll toggle demoMode AFTER this loop correctly.\n          // Actually, the Proxy checks useStore.getState().isDemoMode.\n          // We can temporarily set a \"isBridging\" flag or just toggle demoMode first.\n\n          console.log(`[DemoBridge] Realizing: ${log.module}.${log.method}`);\n          await apiModule[log.method](log.payload);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(`[DemoBridge] Failed to realize ${log.module}.${log.method}:`, err);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  return { exitDemoWithBridge may not be installed\n    return await import('react-native-view-shot');\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n};\nconst loadSharing = () => import('expo-sharing');\nconst loadClipboard = () => import('expo-clipboard');\n\ninterface QRShareButtonProps {\n  /** Canonical gurudevi://qr?... URI produced by QRBuilder */\n  value: string;\n  /** Human-readable label shown below the QR code */\n  label?: string;\n  /** QR code size in pixels */\n  size?: number;\n  /** If provided, this URL is copied/shared instead of the scheme URI */\n  shortUrl?: string;\n  /** Background color for the QR + share block */\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  /** Text color for buttons */\n  accentColor?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRShareButton({\n  value,\n  label,\n  size = 200,\n  shortUrl,\n  backgroundColor = '#1a1a2e',\n  accentColor = '#f5a623',\n}: QRShareButtonProps) {\n  const viewRef = useRef<View>(null);\n\n  const shareUrl = shortUrl ?? value;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Share as image ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n\n  const handleShareImage = async () => {\n    try {\n      const viewShot = await loadViewShot();\n      if (!viewShot) {\n        console.warn('QRShareButton: react-native-view-shot not available');\n        return;\n      }\n      const Sharing = await loadSharing();\n      if (!viewRef.current) return;\n\n      const uri = await viewShot.captureRef(viewRef, { format: 'png', quality: 1 });\n      if (await Sharing.isAvailableAsync()) {\n        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {\n          mimeType: 'image/png',\n          dialogTitle: label ? `Share ${label} QR Code` : 'Share QR Code',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn('QRShareButton: share image failed', err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Copy link ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n\n  const handleCopyLink = async () => {\n    try {\n      const Clipboard = await loadClipboard();\n      await Clipboard.setStringAsync(shareUrl);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn('QRShareButton: copy link failed', err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor }]}>\n      {/* QR code ΓÇö captured by ViewShot */}\n      <View ref={viewRef} collapsable={false} style={[styles.qrWrapper, { backgroundColor }]}>\n        <QRCodeGenerator value={value} size={size} label={label} />\n      </View>\n\n      {/* Action buttons */}\n      <View style={styles.buttonRow}>\n        <TouchableOpacity\n          onPress={handleShareImage}\n          style={[styles.button, { borderColor: accentColor }]}\n          accessibilityLabel=\"Share QR code as image\"\n        >\n          <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: accentColor }]}>≡ƒôñ Share Image</Text>\n        </TouchableOpacity>\n\n        <TouchableOpacity\n          onPress={handleCopyLink}\n          style={[styles.button, { borderColor: accentColor }]}\n          accessibilityLabel=\"Copy QR link to clipboard\"\n        >\n          <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: accentColor }]}>≡ƒöù Copy Link</Text>\n        </TouchableOpacity>\n      </View>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  container: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    gap: 16,\n    padding: 16,\n    borderRadius: 16,\n  },\n  qrWrapper: {\n    padding: 12,\n    borderRadius: 12,\n  },\n  buttonRow: {\n

t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => log.method.startsWith('create') || log.method.startsWith('add'),\n    );\n    const firstItemName =\n      (firstLog?.payload as any)?.name || (firstLog?.payload as any)?.title || 'item';\n\n    hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule = (api as any)[log.module];\n        if (apiModule && typeof apiModule[log.method] === 'function') {\n          // Execute the REAL API call (no proxy interception because we'll be in production mode apiModule[log.method](log.payload);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(`[DemoBridge] Failed to realize ${log.module}.${log.method}:`, err);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  return { useStore } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { api } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { hapticSuccess, hapticWarning } from '../utils/haptics';\n\n/**\n * Hook to handle the \"Bridge to Reality\" flow when exiting Demo Mode.\n * If the user has performed any simulated writes, it prompts them to save.\n */\nexport function useDemoBridge() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => log.method.startsWith('create') || log.method.startsWith('add'),\n    );\n    const firstItemName =\n      (firstLog?.payload as any)?.name || (firstLog?.payload as any)?.title || 'item';\n\n    hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // may not be installed\n    return await import('react-native-view-shot');\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n};\nconst loadSharing = () => import('expo-sharing');\nconst loadClipboard = () => import('expo-clipboard');\n\ninterface QRShareButtonProps {\n  /** Canonical gurudevi://qr?... hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n may not be installed\n    return await import('react-native-view-shot');\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n};\nconst loadSharing = () => import('expo-sharing');\nconst loadClipboard = () => import('expo-clipboard');\n\ninterface QRShareButtonProps {\n  /** Canonical gurudevi://qr?... URI produced by QRBuilder */\n  value: string;\n  /** Human-readable label shown below the QR code */\n  label?: string;\n  /** QR code size in pixels */\n  size?: number;\n  /** If provided, this URL is copied/shared instead of the scheme URI */\n  shortUrl?: string;\n  /** Background color for the QR + share block */\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  /** Text color for buttons */\n  accentColor?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRShareButton({\n  value,\n  label,\n  size = 200,\n  shortUrl,\n  backgroundColor = '#1a1a2e',\n  accentColor = '#f5a623',\n}: QRShareButtonProps) {\n  const viewRef = useRef<View>(null);\n\n  const shareUrl = shortUrl ?? useStore } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { api } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { hapticSuccess, hapticWarning } from '../utils/haptics';\n\n/**\n * Hook to handle the \"Bridge to Reality\" flow when exiting Demo Mode.\n * If the user has performed any simulated writes, it prompts them to save.\n */\nexport function useDemoBridge() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => log.method.startsWith('create') || log.method.startsWith('add'),\n    );\n    const firstItemName =\n      (firstLog?.payload as any)?.name || (firstLog?.payload as any)?.title || 'item';\n\n    hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // Bridge the data to reality\n              await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n\n              hapticSuccess();\n            } finally {\n              setBridging(false);\n              clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule = (api as any)[log.module];\n        if (apiModule && typeof apiModule[log.method] === 'function') {\n          // Execute the REAL API call (no proxy interception because we'll be in production mode hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n useStore } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { api } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport { hapticSuccess, hapticWarning } from '../utils/haptics';\n\n/**\n * Hook to handle the \"Bridge to Reality\" flow when exiting Demo Mode.\n * If the user has performed any simulated writes, it prompts them to save.\n */\nexport function useDemoBridge() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => log.method.startsWith('create') || log.method.startsWith('add'),\n    );\n    const firstItemName =\n      (firstLog?.payload as any)?.name || (firstLog?.payload as any)?.title || 'item';\n\n    hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // Bridge the data to reality\n              await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n\n              hapticSuccess();\n            } finally {\n              setBridging(false);\n              clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule = (api as any)[log.module];\n        if (apiModule && typeof apiModule[log.method] === 'function') {\n          // Execute the REAL API call (no proxy interception because we'll be in production mode or we force it)\n          // Note: Since isDemoMode is still true during this loop,\n          // we need to make sure the proxy doesn't intercept these \"bridging\" calls.\n          // A simple way is to pass a special flag in args or rely on the fact that\n          // we'll toggle demoMode AFTER this loop correctly.\n          // Actually, the Proxy checks useStore.getState().isDemoMode.\n          // We can temporarily set a \"isBridging\" flag or just toggle demoMode first.\n\n          console.log(`[DemoBridge] Realizing: ${log.module}.${log.method}`);\n          await apiModule[log.method](log.payload);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(`[DemoBridge] Failed to realize ${log.module}.${log.method}:`, err);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  return { exitDemoWithBridge console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const
