Using react-native-svg to render\n// the matrix as <Rect> elements means the code looks crisp at any screen density.\n//\n// AESTHETICS:\n// This version supports \"Branded\" QR codes:\n// 1. Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = si
ze / sizeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Render data modules as Dots (Circles)\n    return (\n      <Circle\n        key={`dot-${row}-${col}`}\n        cx={col * cellSize + cellSize / 2}\n        cy={row * cellSize + cellSize / 2}\n        r={cellSize / 2.3} // Slightly smaller than half for a \"dotted\" look\n        fill={color}\n      />\n    );\n  };\n\n  const renderEye = (x: number, y: number) => {\n    const eyeSize = 7 * cellSize;\n    const innerSize = 3 * cellSize;\n    const innerOffset = 2 * cellSize;\n\n    return (\n      <G x={x} y={y}>\n        {/* Outer Ring */}\n        <Rect\n          x={cellSize * 0.5}\n          y={cellSize * 0.5}\n          width={eyeSize - cellSize}\n          height={eyeSize - cellSize}\n          rx={cellSize * 1.5}\n          fill=\"none\"\n          stroke={color}\n          strokeWidth={cellSize}\n        />\n        {/* Inner Dot */}\n        <Rect\n          x={innerOffset + cellSize * 0.5}\n          y={innerOffset + cellSize * 0.5}\n          width={innerSize - cellSize}\n          height={innerSize - cellSize}\n          rx={cellSize * 0.75}\n          fill={color}\n        />\n      </G>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <View style={styles.outerContainer}>\n      {showFrame && (\n        <View style={[styles.frameLabel, { backgroundColor: color }]}>\n          <Text style={styles.frameLabelText}>{frameText.toUpperCase()}</Text>\n        </View>\n      )}\n\n      <View\n        style={[\n          styles.qrWrapper,\n          {\n            borderRadius,\n            padding,\n            backgroundColor,\n            borderColor: showFrame ? color : 'transparent',\n          },\n        ]}\n      >\n        <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>\n          {/* Background fill */}\n          <Rect x=\"0\" y=\"0\" width={size} height={size} fill={backgroundColor} />\n\n          {/* Render Eyes first */}\n          {renderEye(0, 0)}\n          {renderEye((sizeCells - 7) * cellSize, 0)}\n          {renderEye(0, (sizeCells - 7) * cellSize)}\n\n          {/* QR data modules */}\n          {[...matrix.data].map((cell, index) => {\n            const row = Math.floor(index / sizeCells);\n            const col = index % sizeCells;\n            return renderModule(cell, row, col);\n          })}\n\n          {/* Central Lotus Emoji */}\n          {showLotus && (\n            <SvgText\n              x={size / 2}\n              y={size / 2 + cellSize * 1.5} // Adjust for vertical alignment\n              fontSize={cellSize * (centerClearance - 1.5)}\n              textAnchor=\"middle\"\n            >\n              {'\\uD83E\\uDEB7'}\n            </SvgText>\n          )}\n        </Svg>\n      </View>\n\n      {label && <Text style={[styles.label, { color }]}>{label}</Text>}\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  outerContainer: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  qrWrapper: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n    borderWidth: 2,\n  },\n  container: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  label: {\n    marginTop: 12,\n    fontSize: 14,\n    fontWeight: '600',\n    textAlign: 'center',\n    letterSpacing: 0.5,\n  },\n  frameLabel: {\n    paddingHorizontal: 16,\n    paddingVertical: 4,\n    borderTopLeftRadius: 10,\n    borderTopRightRadius: 10,\n    marginBottom: -2, // Slight overlap\n    zIndex: 1,\n  },\n  frameLabelText: {\n    color: 'white',\n    fontSize: 10,\n    fontWeight: 'bold',\n    letterSpacing: 2,\n  },\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\ResonantHeatmap.tsx","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\SanctuaryBackground.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"react-hooks/refs","severity":1,"message":"Error: Cannot access refs during render\n\nReact refs are values that are not needed for rendering. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - just update immediately\n      prevNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n      currentNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n      fadeAnim.setValue(1);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Crossfade: prev layer stays, new layer fades in over 2s\n    prevNodes.current = currentNodes.current;\n    currentNodes.current = gradientNodes;\n\n    fadeAnim.setValue(0);\n    const animation = Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {\n      toValue: 1,\n      duration: 2000,\n      useNativeDriver: true,\n    });\n    animation.start();\n\n    return () => animation.stop();\n    // Note: isDark theme-mode toggles DO trigger a crossfade here to ensure immediate reactive update\n    // of the background gradient nodes.\n  }, [phase, isDark]); // Re-run when phase OR theme mode changes.\n\n  return (\n    <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} pointerEvents=\"none\">\n      {/* Layer 0: Previous phase (fades out) */}\n      <LinearGradient\n        colors={prevNodes.current}\n        start={{ x: 0.1, y: 0 }}\n        end={{ x: 0.9, y: 1 }}\n        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject}\n      />\n      {/* Layer 1: Current phase (fades in) */}\n      <Animated.View\n        style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, { opacity: fadeAnim }]}\n        pointerEvents=\"none\"\n      >\n        <LinearGradient\n          colors={currentNodes.current}\n          start={{ x: 0.2, y: 0 }}\n          end={{ x: 0.8, y: 1 }}\n          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject}\n        />\n      </Animated.View>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\SanctuaryButton.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. setViewDate(today.toISOString().split('T')[0]!);\n        }\n\n        Animated.spring(pan, {\n          toValue: 0,\n          useNativeDriver: false,\n        }).start();\n      },\n    }),\n  ).current;\n\n  const color = phase === 'past' ? </SanctuaryButton>\n              )}\n            </VStack>\n          ) : null\n        }\n      >\n        {pendingRequest && (\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <Box t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule description,\n  onPress,\n  value,\n  isActive,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  accessibilityHint,\n}: SettingsOptionProps) {\n  return (\n    <Pressable\n      onPress={() => {\n        hapticLight();\n        onPress();\n      }}\n      accessible={true}\n      accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel || title}\n      accessibilityHint={accessibilityHint || 'border-phase-primary' : ''}`}\n    >\n      <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center\">\n        <Box\n          className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-[12px] items-center justify-center ${isActive ? 'bg-phase-primary' : 'bg-phase-surface'}`}\n        >\n          {icon}\n        </Box>\n        <VStack className=\"flex-1 gap-1\">\n          <Text className=\"text-base font-semibold text-phase-primary\">{title}</Text>\n          <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary leading-relaxed\">{description}</Text>\n        </VStack>\n        <HStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n          {value && <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary mr-1\">{value}</Text>}\n          <ChevronRight size={20} className=\"text-phase-muted\" />\n        </HStack>\n      </HStack>\n    </Pressable>\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Settings Section Header\n */\nfunction SectionHeader({ title, description }: { title: string; description?: string }) {\n  return (\n    <VStack className=\"gap-1 mb-4 mt-6 px-1\">\n      <Heading size=\"lg\" className=\"text-phase-primary font-bold\">\n        {title}\n      </Heading>\n      {description && (\n        <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary leading-relaxed\">{description}</Text>\n      )}\n    </VStack>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function AppSettingsScreen({ navigation }: any) {\n  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, scene, text: themeText } = useTheme();\n\n  const {\n    themeMode,\n    setThemeMode,\n    temporalPhase,\n    fidelityLevel,\n    setFidelityLevel,\n    language,\n    setLanguage,\n    isVeilActive,\n    toggleVeil,\n    reality,\n    enableLivingTheme,\n    setEnableLivingTheme,\n  } = useEnvironment();\n  const { isDemoMode, setDemoMode, user } = useStore();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n\n  const [showThemeModal, setShowThemeModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showFidelityModal, setShowFidelityModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showLanguageModal, setShowLanguageModal] = useState(false);\n\n  // Theme mode labels\n  const getThemeLabel = () => {\n    if (themeMode === 'system') return t('settings.theme.system');\n    if (themeMode === 'auto') return t('settings.theme.auto');\n    if (themeMode === 'light') return t('settings.theme.light');\n    return t('settings.theme.dark');\n  };\n\n  // Fidelity labels\n  const getFidelityLabel = () => {\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'auto') return t('settings.fidelity.auto');\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'low') return t('settings.fidelity.low');\n    return t('settings.fidelity.high');\n  };\n\n  // Language labels\n  const getLanguageLabel = () => {\n    if (language === 'en') return 'English';\n    if (language === 'si') return 'α╖âα╖Æα╢éα╖äα╢╜';\n    return 'α«ñα««α«┐α«┤α»ì';\n  };\n\n  // Temporal phase description\n  const getTemporalDescription = () => {\n    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(i18n.language, {\n      hour: 'numeric',\n      minute: '2-digit',\n    });\n    const phases = {\n      predawn: t('settings.temporal.predawn'),\n      dawn: t('settings.temporal.dawn'),\n      morning: t('settings.temporal.morning'),\n      afternoon: t('settings.temporal.afternoon'),\n      dusk: t('settings.temporal.dusk'),\n      night: t('settings.temporal.night'),\n    };\n    return `${phases[temporalPhase as keyof typeof phases]} ΓÇó ${time}`;\n  };\n\n  const handleThemeChange = (mode: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto') => {\n    setThemeMode(mode);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowThemeModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleFidelityChange = async (level: 'auto' | 'low' | 'high') => {\n    await setFidelityLevel(level);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowFidelityModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = async (lang: 'en' | 'si' | 'ta') => {\n    await setLanguage(lang);\n    await i18n.changeLanguage(lang);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowLanguageModal(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Box <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Sparkles size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title={t('settings.fidelity.title')}\n          description={\n            fidelityLevel === t('settings.fidelity.high_desc')\n          }\n          value={getFidelityLabel()}\n          onPress={() => setShowFidelityModal(true)}\n          accessibilityLabel={t('settings.fidelity.title')}\n rounded-[20px] ${enableLivingTheme ? {enableLivingTheme\n                    ? t('settings.living_theme.on')\n                    : t('settings.living_theme.off')}\n                </Text>\n              </VStack>\n accessibilityRole=\"switch\"\n              accessibilityLabel={t('settings.living_theme.title')}\n              accessibilityState={{ checked: enableLivingTheme }}\n            />\n Auditor\n *\n * Scans Theme.ts and phaseMatrix for contrast violations using APCA and WCAG 2.1.\n * Run with: npx tsx scripts/audit-theme.ts\n */\n\nimport { colors, phaseMatrix, resolvePhaseTokens } from '../src/theme/Theme';\nimport { checkAccessibility, toHex } from '../src/utils/a11yUtils';\nimport { TemporalPhase } from '../src/context/types';\n\nconst PHASES: TemporalPhase[] = ['predawn', 'dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'dusk', 'night'];\nconst MODES: ('light' | 'dark')[] = ['light', 'dark'];\n\nconsole.log('\\x1b[36m%s\\x1b[0m', '--- GURUDEVI THEME ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT ---');\nconsole.log('Validating Sanctuary tokens against WCAG 2.1 and APCA Standards...\\n');\n\nlet violations = 0;\nlet totalChecks = 0;\n\nfunction report(\n  label: string,\n  fg: string,\n  bg: string,\n  requirement: { wcag?: number; apca?: number },\n) {\n  totalChecks++;\n  const fgHex = toHex(fg);\n  const bgHex = toHex(bg);\n  const { ratio, apca, apcaRating } = checkAccessibility(fgHex, bgHex);\n\n  let failed = false;\n  const details = [];\n\n  if (requirement.wcag && ratio < requirement.wcag) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`WCAG: ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 (Min ${requirement.wcag})`);\n  }\n\n  if (requirement.apca && Math.abs(apca) < requirement.apca) {\n    failed = true;\n    details.push(`APCA: ${apca.toFixed(1)} Lc (Min ${requirement.apca} - ${apcaRating})`);\n  }\n\n  if (failed) {\n    violations++;\n    console.log(`\\x1b[31m[FAIL]\\x1b[0m ${label}`);\n    console.log(`       - BG: ${bgHex}, FG: ${fgHex}`);\n    console.log(`       - ${details.join(' | ')}`);\n  }\n}\n\n// 1. Audit Phase Matrix\nPHASES.forEach((phase) => {\n  MODES.forEach((mode) => {\n    const isDark = mode === 'dark';\n    const tokens = resolvePhaseTokens(phase, isDark);\n\n    // Primary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Primary Text`, tokens.text.primary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 75,\n    });\n\n    // Secondary Text Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Secondary Text`, tokens.text.secondary, tokens.gradientNodes[0], {\n      wcag: 3.0,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n\n    // Accent Action Contrast\n    report(`${phase}/${mode} Accent Action`, tokens.text.inverse, tokens.accent.action, {\n      wcag: 4.5,\n      apca: 60,\n    });\n  });\n});\n\nconsole.log('\\n--- AUDIT SUMMARY ---');\nif (violations === 0) {\n  console.log(`\\x1b[32mSUCCESS: All ${totalChecks} checks passed.\\x1b[0m`);\n  process.exit(0);\n} else {\n  console.log(\n    `\\x1b[31mWARNING: Found ${violations} accessibility violations across ${totalChecks} checks.\\x1b[0m`,\n  );\n  // We don't exit with 1 yet to avoid breaking builds until we fix the colors\n       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const await accountPin.verifyPin(account.accountId, values.pin);\n        if (!ok) {\n          throw new Error('PIN did not match this account.');\n        }\n        await const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = Dots instead of squares (Circle modules)\n// 2. Styled Finder Patterns (Rounded \"Eyes\")\n// 3. Central Logo (Lotus emoji) enabled by High Error Correction\n// 4. \"Scan Me\" branding frame\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport Svg, { Rect, Circle, G, Text as SvgText } from 'react-native-svg';\nimport { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';\nimport QRCode from 'qrcode';\n\nexport interface QRCodeGeneratorProps {\n  value: string;\n  size?: number;\n  /** Foreground (module) color */\n  color?: string;\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  label?: string;\n  /** Error correction level \\u2014 H = 30% recovery (default), M = 15%, L = 7% */\n  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H';\n  /** Border radius for the container */\n  borderRadius?: number;\n  /** Padding inside the container */\n  padding?: number;\n  /** Show the central lotus emoji */\n  showLotus?: boolean;\n  /** Show the \"SCAN ME\" frame */\n  showFrame?: boolean;\n  /** Custom text for the frame label (defaults to \"SCAN ME\") */\n  frameText?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodeGenerator({\n  value,\n  size = 180, // Slightly larger base size for aesthetic codes\n  color = '#000000',\n  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',\n  label,\n  errorCorrectionLevel = 'H',\n  borderRadius = 20,\n  padding = 24,\n  showLotus = true,\n  showFrame = true,\n  frameText = 'SCAN ME',\n}: QRCodeGeneratorProps) {\n  if (!value) return null;\n\n  const matrix = useMemo(() => {\n    try {\n      const qr = QRCode.create(value, { errorCorrectionLevel });\n      return qr.modules;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('QR Generation Error', e);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [value, errorCorrectionLevel]);\n\n  if (!matrix || matrix.size === 0) {\n    return (\n      <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>\n        <Text>Invalid QR data</Text>\n      </View>\n    );\n  }\n\n  const sizeCells = matrix.size;\n  const cellSize = si
ze / sizeCells;\n\n  // Area to clear for the central logo (in module coordinates)\n  // For 'H' error correction, we can safely clear a ~20-25% center area.\n  const centerClearance = Math.floor(sizeCells * 0.25);\n  const centerStart = Math.floor((sizeCells - centerClearance) / 2);\n  const centerEnd = centerStart + centerClearance;\n\n  const renderModule = (cell: number, row: number, col: number) => {\n    if (!cell) return null;\n\n    // 1. Check if it's a Finder Pattern (the 3 eyes)\n    // Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left 7x7 areas\n    const isEye =\n      (row < 7 && col < 7) ||\n      (row < 7 && col >= sizeCells - 7) ||\n      (row >= sizeCells - 7 && col < 7);\n\n    // 2. Check if it's in the center logo area\n    const isCenter =\n      showLotus && row >= centerStart && row < centerEnd && col >= centerStart && col < centerEnd;\n\n    if (isCenter) return null;\n\n    if (isEye) {\n      // We'll render eyes separately outside the module loop for better styling\n      // or just skip them here for data loop\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 3. 2 LinearGradient layers crossfading.\n * Low/Battery: Static LinearGradient snapshot - same palette, zero animation cost.\n *\n * Phase transitions: 2s crossfade between palettes.\n */\nimport React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { StyleSheet, View, Animated } from 'react-native';\nimport { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\n\nexport function SanctuaryBackground() {\n  const { gradientNodes, animationsEnabled, phase, isDark } = useTheme();\n\n  // Two gradient layers for crossfade transition\n  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;\n  const prevNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n  const currentNodes = useRef<[string, string, string]>(gradientNodes);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!animationsEnabled) {\n      // Static - Philosophy: Simple, reusable foundation for UI cards\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Pressable, Platform } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, { useSharedValue, TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface SanctuaryCardProps {\n  title?: string;\n  children: any;\n  footer?: any;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  onLongPress?: () => void;\n  href?: string;\n  target?: '_blank' | '_self';\n  elevated?: boolean;\n  style?: any;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL = 1.0;\nconst LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED = 1.02;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst SanctuaryCard: FC<SanctuaryCardProps> = ({\n  title,\n  children,\n  footer,\n  onPress,\n  onLongPress,\n  href,\n  target = '_self',\n  elevated = false,\n  style,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  // Hover state - only meaningful on web (desktop pointer devices)\n  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);\n\n  // Shared value for lift animation\n  const scale = useSharedValue(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION: LIFT EFFECT (when pressable)\n  // });\n\n  const handlePressIn = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_PRESSED, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePressOut = () => {\n    if (onPress || href) {\n      scale.value = withSpring(LIFT_SCALE_NORMAL, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // RENDER: Container Level\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const overflow-hidden\n                ${elevated ? 'shadow-xl shadow-black/20' : ''}\n                ${hovered && Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'opacity-90 scale-[1.01]' : ''}\n                ${className || ''}\n            `}\n    >\n      <VStack className=\"p-6\">\n        {/* Title Section */}\n        {title && <Text className=\"text-xl font-bold text-phase-text-primary mb-4\">{title}</Text>}\n\n        {/* Children Content */}\n        <Box className=\"gap-4\">{children}</Box>\n\n        {/* Footer Section */}\n        {footer && (\n          <VStack className=\"mt-4 gap-4\">\n            <Box className=\"h-px bg-white/5 opacity-30\" />\n            {footer}\n          </VStack>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress || href) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable\n        onPress={onPress}\n        onLongPress={onLongPress}\n        onPressIn={handlePressIn}\n        onPressOut={handlePressOut}\n        onHoverIn={Platform.OS === 'web' ? * Determines the temporal phase based on current time\n * - Predawn:   4 AM - 6 AM  (dark)\n * - Dawn:      6 AM - 9 AM  (light)\n * - Morning:   9 AM - 12 PM (light)\n * - Afternoon: 12 PM - 5 PM (light)\n * - Dusk:      5 PM - 8 PM  (dark)\n * - Night:     8 PM - 4 AM  (dark, wraps midnight)\n */\nexport function getTemporalPhase(): TemporalPhase {\n  const hour = new Date().getHours();\n  if (hour >= 4 && hour < 6) return 'predawn';\n  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 9) return 'dawn';\n  if (hour >= 9 && hour < 12) return 'morning';\n  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 17) return 'afternoon';\n  if (hour >= 17 && hour < 20) return 'dusk';\n  return 'night';\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines if current temporal phase should use dark theme\n */\nexport function shouldUseDarkTheme(phase: TemporalPhase): boolean {\n  return phase === 'predawn' || phase === 'dusk' || phase === 'night';\n  // dawn, morning, afternoon \\u2192 light world\n}\n\n/**\n * Detects device performance tier based on available memory\n * - Low: < 3GB RAM\n * - Medium: 3-6GB RAM\n * - High: > 6GB RAM\n */\nexport async function detectDeviceTier(): Promise<{ tier: DeviceTier; memoryGB: number }> {\n  try {\n    // Get total memory if available\n    const totalMemory = Device.totalMemory;\n\n    if (!totalMemory) {\n      // If we can't detect, assume medium tier to be safe\n      return { tier: 'medium', memoryGB: 4 };\n    }\n\n    const memoryGB = totalMemory / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);\n\n    let tier: DeviceTier;\n    if (memoryGB < 3) {\n      tier = 'low';\n    } else if (memoryGB < 6) {\n      tier = 'medium';\n    } else {\n      tier = 'high';\n    }\n\n    return { tier, memoryGB };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('Failed to detect device tier:', error);\n    return { tier: 'medium', memoryGB: 4 };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Detects network quality based on connection info\n */\nexport async function detectNetworkQuality(): Promise<NetworkQuality> {\n  try {\n    const netInfo = await NetInfo.fetch();\n\n    if (!netInfo.isConnected) {\n      return 'offline';\n    }\n\n    // Check connection type and effective type\n    const type = netInfo.type;\n    const details = netInfo.details as any;\n\n    // If we have cellular connection, check the type\n    if (type === 'cellular') {\n      const cellularGeneration = details?.cellularGeneration;\n\n      if (cellularGeneration === '5g') {\n        return 'excellent';\n      } else if (cellularGeneration === '4g') {\n        return 'good';\n      } else if (cellularGeneration === '3g') {\n        return 'fair';\n      } else {\n        return 'poor';\n      }\n    }\n\n    // For WiFi, assume good quality unless we have more info\n    if (type === 'wifi') {\n      return 'good';\n    }\n\n    // Default to fair for other connection types\n    return 'fair';\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('Failed to detect network quality:', error);\n    return 'fair';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines if data saver mode should be active based on network quality\n */\nexport function shouldUseDataSaver(quality: NetworkQuality): boolean {\n  return quality === 'poor' || quality === 'fair';\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines effective fidelity level based on settings and reality\n */\nexport function computeEffectiveFidelity(\n  fidelityLevel: 'auto' | 'low' | 'high',\n  deviceTier: DeviceTier,\n): 'low' | 'high' {\n  // If user explicitly chose, respect their choice\n  if (fidelityLevel === 'low') return 'low';\n  if (fidelityLevel === 'high') return 'high';\n\n  // Auto mode: base on device tier\n  return deviceTier === 'low' ? * Hook to handle the \"Bridge to Reality\" flow when exiting Demo Mode.\n * If the user has performed any simulated writes, it prompts them to save.\n */\nexport function useDemoBridge() {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { demoLogs, clearDemoLogs, setDemoMode } = useStore() as any;\n\n  const exitDemoWithBridge = async () => {\n    if (demoLogs.length === 0) {\n      setDemoMode(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the name of the first item created for a personalized message\n    const firstLog = demoLogs.find(\n      (log: any) => hapticWarning();\n\n    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {\n      // Two-action demo bridge - window.confirm is acceptable for this destructive choice on web\n      const save = window.confirm(\n        t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      );\n      if (save) {\n        const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n        try {\n          setBridging(true);\n          await processDemoLogs(demoLogs);\n          hapticSuccess();\n        } finally {\n          setBridging(false);\n          clearDemoLogs();\n          setDemoMode(false);\n        }\n      } else {\n        clearDemoLogs();\n        setDemoMode(false);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    Alert.alert(\n      t('demoMode.bridgeTitle'),\n      t('demoMode.bridgeMessage', { count: demoLogs.length, firstName: firstItemName }),\n      [\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeDiscard'),\n          style: 'destructive',\n          onPress: () => {\n            clearDemoLogs();\n            setDemoMode(false);\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          text: t('demoMode.bridgeSave'),\n          onPress: async () => {\n            const { setBridging } = useStore.getState() as any;\n            try {\n              // Enable bridging mode to bypass API interception\n              setBridging(true);\n\n              // clearDemoLogs();\n              setDemoMode(false);\n            }\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    );\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Processes the shadow logs and executes real API calls.\n   */\n  const processDemoLogs = async (logs: any[]) => {\n    console.log(`[DemoBridge] Processing ${logs.length} logs for reality...`);\n\n    for (const log of logs) {\n      try {\n        const apiModule apiModule[log.method](log.payload);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(`[DemoBridge] Failed to realize ${log.module}.${log.method}:`, err);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  return { may not be installed\n    return await import('react-native-view-shot');\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n};\nconst loadSharing = () => import('expo-sharing');\nconst loadClipboard = () => import('expo-clipboard');\n\ninterface QRShareButtonProps {\n  /** Canonical gurudevi://qr?... URI produced by QRBuilder */\n  value: string;\n  /** Human-readable label shown below the QR code */\n  label?: string;\n  /** QR code size in pixels */\n  size?: number;\n  /** If provided, this URL is copied/shared instead of the scheme URI */\n  shortUrl?: string;\n  /** Background color for the QR + share block */\n  backgroundColor?: string;\n  /** Text color for buttons */\n  accentColor?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRShareButton({\n  value,\n  label,\n  size = 200,\n  shortUrl,\n  backgroundColor = '#1a1a2e',\n  accentColor = '#f5a623',\n}: QRShareButtonProps) {\n  const viewRef = useRef<View>(null);\n\n  const shareUrl = shortUrl ?? value;\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Share as image ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n\n  const handleShareImage = async () => {\n    try {\n      const viewShot = await loadViewShot();\n      if (!viewShot) {\n        console.warn('QRShareButton: react-native-view-shot not available');\n        return;\n      }\n      const Sharing = await loadSharing();\n      if (!viewRef.current) return;\n\n      const uri = await viewShot.captureRef(viewRef, { format: 'png', quality: 1 });\n      if (await Sharing.isAvailableAsync()) {\n        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {\n          mimeType: 'image/png',\n          dialogTitle: label ? `Share ${label} QR Code` : 'Share QR Code',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn('QRShareButton: share image failed', err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // ΓöÇΓöÇ Copy link ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ\n\n  const handleCopyLink = async () => {\n    try {\n      const Clipboard = await loadClipboard();\n      await Clipboard.setStringAsync(shareUrl);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn('QRShareButton: copy link failed', err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor }]}>\n      {/* QR code ΓÇö captured by ViewShot */}\n      <View ref={viewRef} collapsable={false} style={[styles.qrWrapper, { backgroundColor }]}>\n        <QRCodeGenerator value={value} size={size} label={label} />\n      </View>\n\n      {/* Action buttons */}\n      <View style={styles.buttonRow}>\n        <TouchableOpacity\n          onPress={handleShareImage}\n          style={[styles.button, { borderColor: accentColor }]}\n          accessibilityLabel=\"Share QR code as image\"\n        >\n          <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: accentColor }]}>≡ƒôñ Share Image</Text>\n        </TouchableOpacity>\n\n        <TouchableOpacity\n          onPress={handleCopyLink}\n          style={[styles.button, { borderColor: accentColor }]}\n          accessibilityLabel=\"Copy QR link to clipboard\"\n        >\n          <Text style={[styles.buttonText, { color: accentColor }]}>≡ƒöù Copy Link</Text>\n        </TouchableOpacity>\n      </View>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  container: {\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    gap: 16,\n    padding: 16,\n    borderRadius: 16,\n  },\n  qrWrapper: {\n    padding: 12,\n    borderRadius: 12,\n  },\n  buttonRow: {\n

React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { ScrollView, Switch } from 'react-native';\nimport { Box, VStack, HStack, Heading, Text, Button, ButtonText, Pressable } from '../gluestack';\nimport ScreenWrapper from '../components/ScreenWrapper';\nimport { useEnvironment } from '../context';\nimport { useTheme } from '../hooks/useTheme';\nimport { useSanctuaryToast } from '../providers/ToastProvider';\nimport { hapticLight, hapticSuccess } from '../utils/haptics';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\nimport {\n  Sun,\n  Moon,\n  Smartphone,\n  Sparkles,\n  Eye,\n  EyeOff,\n  Globe,\n  Type,\n  ChevronRight,\n  Check,\n  Info,\n  Zap,\n  Shield,\n} from 'lucide-react-native';\n\nimport { useStore } from '@repo/core/logic';\nimport { DeviceAccountManager } from '../components';\n\ninterface SettingsOptionProps {\n  icon: React.ReactNode;\n  title: string;\n  description: string;\n  onPress: () => void;\n  value?: string;\n  isActive?: boolean;\n  accessibilityLabel?: string;\n  accessibilityHint?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Reusable Settings Option Component\n * Accessible and touch-friendly\n */\nfunction SettingsOption({\n  icon,\n  title,\n  description,\n  onPress,\n  value,\n  isActive,\n  accessibilityLabel,\n  accessibilityHint,\n}: SettingsOptionProps) {\n  return (\n    <Pressable\n      onPress={() => {\n        hapticLight();\n        onPress();\n      }}\n      accessible={true}\n      accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel || title}\n      accessibilityHint={accessibilityHint || description}\n      className={`bg-phase-surface border border-phase-border p-4 mb-2 rounded-[20px] min-h-[72px] active:opacity-80 transition-all ${isActive ? 'border-phase-primary' : ''}`}\n    >\n      <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center\">\n        <Box\n          className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-[12px] items-center justify-center ${isActive ? 'bg-phase-primary' : 'bg-phase-surface'}`}\n        >\n          {icon}\n        </Box>\n        <VStack className=\"flex-1 gap-1\">\n          <Text className=\"text-base font-semibold text-phase-primary\">{title}</Text>\n          <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary leading-relaxed\">{description}</Text>\n        </VStack>\n        <HStack className=\"gap-2 items-center\">\n          {value && <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary mr-1\">{value}</Text>}\n          <ChevronRight size={20} className=\"text-phase-muted\" />\n        </HStack>\n      </HStack>\n    </Pressable>\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Settings Section Header\n */\nfunction SectionHeader({ title, description }: { title: string; description?: string }) {\n  return (\n    <VStack className=\"gap-1 mb-4 mt-6 px-1\">\n      <Heading size=\"lg\" className=\"text-phase-primary font-bold\">\n        {title}\n      </Heading>\n      {description && (\n        <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary leading-relaxed\">{description}</Text>\n      )}\n    </VStack>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function AppSettingsScreen({ navigation }: any) {\n  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();\n  const { accent, scene, text: themeText } = useTheme();\n\n  const {\n    themeMode,\n    setThemeMode,\n    temporalPhase,\n    fidelityLevel,\n    setFidelityLevel,\n    language,\n    setLanguage,\n    isVeilActive,\n    toggleVeil,\n    reality,\n    enableLivingTheme,\n    setEnableLivingTheme,\n  } = useEnvironment();\n  const { isDemoMode, setDemoMode, user } = useStore();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n\n  const [showThemeModal, setShowThemeModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showFidelityModal, setShowFidelityModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showLanguageModal, setShowLanguageModal] = useState(false);\n\n  // Theme mode labels\n  const getThemeLabel = () => {\n    if (themeMode === 'system') return t('settings.theme.system');\n    if (themeMode === 'auto') return t('settings.theme.auto');\n    if (themeMode === 'light') return t('settings.theme.light');\n    return t('settings.theme.dark');\n  };\n\n  // Fidelity labels\n  const getFidelityLabel = () => {\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'auto') return t('settings.fidelity.auto');\n    if (fidelityLevel === 'low') return t('settings.fidelity.low');\n    return t('settings.fidelity.high');\n  };\n\n  // Language labels\n  const getLanguageLabel = () => {\n    if (language === 'en') return 'English';\n    if (language === 'si') return 'α╖âα╖Æα╢éα╖äα╢╜';\n    return 'α«ñα««α«┐α«┤α»ì';\n  };\n\n  // Temporal phase description\n  const getTemporalDescription = () => {\n    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(i18n.language, {\n      hour: 'numeric',\n      minute: '2-digit',\n    });\n    const phases = {\n      predawn: t('settings.temporal.predawn'),\n      dawn: t('settings.temporal.dawn'),\n      morning: t('settings.temporal.morning'),\n      afternoon: t('settings.temporal.afternoon'),\n      dusk: t('settings.temporal.dusk'),\n      night: t('settings.temporal.night'),\n    };\n    return `${phases[temporalPhase as keyof typeof phases]} ΓÇó ${time}`;\n  };\n\n  const handleThemeChange = (mode: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto') => {\n    setThemeMode(mode);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowThemeModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleFidelityChange = async (level: 'auto' | 'low' | 'high') => {\n    await setFidelityLevel(level);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowFidelityModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = async (lang: 'en' | 'si' | 'ta') => {\n    await setLanguage(lang);\n    await i18n.changeLanguage(lang);\n    hapticSuccess();\n    setShowLanguageModal(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Box className=\"flex-1 bg-phase-world\">\n      <ScrollView\n        style={{ flex: 1 }}\n        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}\n        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16 }}\n      >\n        {/* Appearance Section */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('settings.appearance.title')}\n          description={t('settings.appearance.description')}\n        />\n\n        <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Sparkles size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title={t('settings.fidelity.title')}\n          description={\n            fidelityLevel === 'auto'\n              ? t('settings.fidelity.auto_desc')\n              : fidelityLevel === 'low'\n                ? t('settings.fidelity.low_desc')\n                : t('settings.fidelity.high_desc')\n          }\n          value={getFidelityLabel()}\n          onPress={() => setShowFidelityModal(true)}\n          accessibilityLabel={t('settings.fidelity.title')}\n          accessibilityHint={t('settings.fidelity.hint')}\n        />\n\n        {/* Living Theme Toggle */}\n        <Box\n          className={`bg-phase-surface border border-phase-border p-4 mb-2 rounded-[20px] ${enableLivingTheme ? 'border-phase-primary' : ''}`}\n        >\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center justify-between\">\n            <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center flex-1\">\n              <Box\n                className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-[12px] items-center justify-center ${enableLivingTheme ? 'bg-phase-primary' : 'bg-phase-surface'}`}\n              >\n                <Sparkles\n                  size={24}\n                  className={enableLivingTheme ? 'text-phase-world' : 'text-phase-muted'}\n                  fill={enableLivingTheme ? 'currentColor' : 'transparent'}\n                />\n              </Box>\n              <VStack className=\"flex-1 gap-1\">\n                <Text className=\"text-base font-semibold text-phase-primary\">\n                  {t('settings.living_theme.title')}\n                </Text>\n                <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary\">\n                  {enableLivingTheme\n                    ? t('settings.living_theme.on')\n                    : t('settings.living_theme.off')}\n                </Text>\n              </VStack>\n            </HStack>\n            <Switch\n              value={enableLivingTheme}\n              onValueChange={async (val) => {\n                await setEnableLivingTheme(val);\n                hapticLight();\n              }}\n              trackColor={{ false: '#4B5563', true: accent.action }}\n              thumbColor=\"#FFFFFF\"\n              accessible={true}\n              accessibilityRole=\"switch\"\n              accessibilityLabel={t('settings.living_theme.title')}\n              accessibilityState={{ checked: enableLivingTheme }}\n            />\n          </HStack>\n        </Box>\n\n        {/* Language & Localization */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('settings.language.title')}\n          description={t('settings.language.description')}\n        />\n        <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Globe size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title={t('settings.language.current')}\n          description={t('settings.language.change_desc')}\n          value={getLanguageLabel()}\n          onPress={() => setShowLanguageModal(true)}\n          accessibilityLabel={t('settings.language.current')}\n          accessibilityHint={t('settings.language.hint')}\n        />\n\n        {/* Profile Visibility & Preview */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('profile.privacy.title', 'Profile & Visibility')}\n          description={t('profile.privacy.description', 'Manage how others see your profile')}\n        />\n        <Box className=\"bg-phase-surface border border-phase-border p-4 mb-2 rounded-[20px]\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center justify-between\">\n            <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-center flex-1\">\n              <Box className=\"w-10 h-10 rounded-[12px] bg-phase-surface items-center justify-center border border-phase-border\">\n                <Shield size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />\n              </Box>\n              <VStack className=\"flex-1 gap-1\">\n                <Text className=\"text-base font-semibold text-phase-primary\">\n                  {t('profile.privacy.publicProfile', 'Public Social Profile')}\n                </Text>\n                <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary\">\n                  {user?.public_profile !== false\n                    ? t('profile.privacy.public_on', 'Others can find and view your profile')\n                    : t('profile.privacy.public_off', 'Your profile is hidden from the community')}\n                </Text>\n              </VStack>\n            </HStack>\n            <Switch\n              value={user?.public_profile !== false}\n              onValueChange={async (val) => {\n                hapticLight();\n                showToast({\n                  message: t('settings.profile_visibility_updated', 'Profile visibility updated'),\n                  type: 'success',\n                });\n              }}\n              trackColor={{ false: '#4B5563', true: accent.action }}\n              thumbColor=\"#FFFFFF\"\n            />\n          </HStack>\n        </Box>\n        <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Eye size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title={t('profile.privacy.previewProfile', 'See how others see you')}\n          description={t('profile.privacy.preview_desc', 'View your own public profile card')}\n          onPress={() => {\n            hapticLight();\n            navigation.navigate('Community', {\n              screen: 'UserProfile',\n              params: {\n                userId: user?.id,\n                userName: user?.full_name,\n              },\n            });\n          }}\n        />\n\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('profile.account.actions', 'Shared device accounts')}\n          description={t(\n            'profile.account.shared_device_desc',\n            'Switch, protect, and remove accounts stored on this device.',\n          )}\n        />\n        <DeviceAccountManager compact={true} />\n\n        {/* Device Info Section */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('settings.device.title')}\n          description={t('settings.device.description')}\n        />\n        <Box className=\"bg-phase-surface border border-phase-border p-5 mb-4 rounded-[20px]\">\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <HStack className=\"justify-between items-center\">\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary\">{t('settings.device.tier')}</Text>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-primary font-semibold\">\n                {reality.deviceTier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + reality.deviceTier.slice(1)}\n              </Text>\n            </HStack>\n            <HStack className=\"justify-between items-center\">\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary\">{t('settings.device.memory')}</Text>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-primary font-semibold\">\n                {reality.totalMemoryGB.toFixed(1)} GB\n              </Text>\n            </HStack>\n            <HStack className=\"justify-between items-center\">\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-secondary\">{t('settings.device.network')}</Text>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-primary font-semibold\">\n                {reality.networkQuality.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + reality.networkQuality.slice(1)}\n              </Text>\n            </HStack>\n            {reality.isDataSaverMode && (\n              <Box className=\"bg-phase-world p-3 rounded-xl border border-phase-border flex-row items-center gap-2\">\n                <Info size={16} className=\"text-phase-primary\" />\n                <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-primary\">\n                  {t('settings.device.data_saver')}\n                </Text>\n              </Box>\n            )}\n          </VStack>\n        </Box>\n\n        {/* Support Section */}\n        <SectionHeader\n          title={t('settings.support.title', 'Support')}\n          description={t('settings.support.description', 'Help us improve Gurudevi')}\n        />\n        <SettingsOption\n          icon={<Zap size={24} className=\"text-phase-secondary\" />}\n          title=\"Trube Lab\"\n          description=\"Tune living surfaces as solo, duet, or orchestra compositions.\"\n          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('TrubeLab')}\n          accessibilityLabel=\"Open Trube Lab\"\n          accessibilityHint=\"Experiment with living surface compositions and lighting.\"\n        />\n\n        {/* Gentle guidance footer */}\n        <Box className=\"p-5 bg-phase-surface/50 border border-phase-border rounded-[24px] mt-6 mb-12\">\n          <HStack className=\"gap-4 items-start\">\n            <Info size={20} className=\"text-phase-primary\" />\n            <VStack className=\"flex-1 gap-1\">\n              <Text className=\"text-sm font-bold text-phase-primary\">\n                {t('settings.tip.title')}\n              </Text>\n              <Text className=\"text-sm text-phase-secondary leading-relaxed\">\n                {t('settings.tip.message')}\n              </Text>\n            </VStack>\n          </HStack>\n        </Box>\n      </ScrollView>\n\n      {/* Fidelity Selection Modal */}\n      {showFidelityModal ({\n    step,\n    title,\n    subtitle,\n    children,\n  }: {\n    step: string;\n    title: string;\n    subtitle: string;\n    children: React.ReactNode;\n  }) => (\n    <VStack className=\"flex-1 border-b border-phase-border\">\n          <VStack className=\"gap-4\">\n            <HStack className=\"gap-2 flex-wrap\">\n              {JOURNEY_PILLARS.map((pillar) => (\n                <Box\n                  key={pillar}\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-phase-canvas border border-phase-border\"\n                >\n                  <Text className=\"text-xs text-phase-text-secondary font-bold\">{pillar}</Text>\n                </Box>\n              ))}\n            </HStack>\n            <ProgressIndicator currentStep={currentStep} totalSteps={TOTAL_STEPS} />\n            <VStack className=\"gap-1\">\n              <Text className=\"text-xs text-phase-accent font-bold tracking-widest uppercase\">\n                {step}\n              </Text>\n              <Heading size=\"2xl\" className=\"text-phase-text-primary\">\n                {title}\n              </Heading>\n              <Text className=\"text-phase-text-secondary\">{subtitle}</Text>\n            </VStack>\n          </VStack>\n        </Box>\n        <Box className=\"px-6 py-8\">{children}</Box>\n      </Box>\n     if (saved) {\n          const progress = JSON.parse(saved);\n          if (!internalId || progress.userId === internalId) {\n            if (progress.name) setName(progress.name);\n            if      return;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {\n        /* ignore corrupt storage */\n      }\n\n      // No saved progress ΓÇö pre-fill for verified (non-anonymous) users with a       console.log('≡ƒº¡ OnboardingScreen: No internalId found, initiating anonymous session...');\n        await authAPI.signInAnonymously();\n        // Re-run the initialization once signed in\n handleCompleteOnboarding();\n  };\n\n  const handleCompleteOnboarding = async () => {\n    setIsCompleting(true);\n    try {\n      const internalId = await identityAPI.getMyInternalId();\n      if (!internalId)\n        throw new Error('Failed to resolve internal user ID during onboarding completion');\n\n      hapticSuccess();\n\n      // Check if user already exists in public.users to avoid overwriting critical data\n      const { data: existingProfile } = await supabase\n        .from('users')\n        .select('school_id')\n        .eq('id', internalId)\n        .single();\n\n      // * LOTUS PETAL FAB - Floating Action Button\n *\n * A petal-shaped floating action button with:\n * - Golden Lotus Art image\n * - Breathing animation (4-second cycle)\n * - Context-aware icons per tab\n * - Press animation with haptic feedback\n * - Floating bubble physics for dragging\n *\n * Philosophy: Organic, living UI that breathes with intention\n */\n\nimport React, { FC, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback, useState, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, PanResponder, Dimensions, Image } from 'react-native';\nimport Animated, {\n  useAnimatedStyle,\n  withRepeat,\n  withTiming,\n  withSequence,\n  withSpring,\n  interpolate,\n  SharedValue,\n  Extrapolate,\n  useSharedValue,\n  Easing,\n  runOnJS,\n} from 'react-native-reanimated';\nimport * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';\nimport { Flower2, Plus, MessageCircle, Upload, Edit } from 'lucide-react-native';\nimport { Theme } from '../theme/Theme';\nimport { useAccessibility } from '../hooks/useAccessibility';\n\n// ============================================================================\n// TYPES\n// ============================================================================\n\ntype TabType = 'self' | 'classroom' | 'community' | 'library' | 'profile';\n\nexport interface ActionItem {\n  label: string;\n  onPress: () => void;\n  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n}\n\ninterface LotusPetalFABProps {\n  currentTab?: TabType;\n  onPress?: () => void;\n  icon?: React.ReactNode;\n  actions?: ActionItem[];\n  scrollY?: SharedValue<number>;\n  disabled?: boolean;\n  bottomInset?: number; // New prop for safe area handling\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// CONSTANTS\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst FAB_SIZE = 72; // Slightly larger for the art\nconst FAB_HIT_SLOP = 10;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SIZE = 48;\nconst ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING = 12;\nconst LONG_PRESS_DURATION = 400; // milliseconds\nconst SCREEN_WIDTH = Dimensions.get('window').width;\n\n// Context-aware configuration\ntype IconComponentType = React.ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string; strokeWidth: number }>;\n\nconst fabConfig: Record<TabType, { IconComponent: IconComponentType; label: string }> = {\n  self: {\n    IconComponent: Flower2,\n    label: 'Log mood',\n  },\n  classroom: {\n    IconComponent: Plus,\n    label: 'Create lesson',\n  },\n  community: {\n    IconComponent: MessageCircle,\n    label: 'Post announcement',\n  },\n  library: {\n    IconComponent: Upload,\n    label: 'Upload resource',\n  },\n  profile: {\n    IconComponent: Edit,\n    label: 'Edit profile',\n  },\n};\n\nconst LOTUS_IMAGE = require('../../assets/images/lotus_bloom.png');\n\n// ============================================================================\n// MAIN COMPONENT\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst LotusPetalFAB: FC<LotusPetalFABProps> = ({\n  currentTab = 'self',\n  onPress,\n  icon,\n  actions,\n  scrollY,\n  disabled = true,\n  bottomInset = Theme.spacing.lg, // Default value if not provided\n}) => {\n  const { isReduceMotionEnabled, announce } = useAccessibility();\n\n  // TEMPORARY: Return null if disabled to completely hide the FAB\n  if (disabled) return null;\n\n  // Shared value for press animation\n  const pressScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  // Shared value for breathing animation\n  const breathingScale = useSharedValue(0.95);\n  // Position for dragging\n  const translateX = useSharedValue(0);\n  const translateY = useSharedValue(0);\n  // Base position accumulator\n  const baseX = useRef(0);\n  const baseY = useRef(0);\n  // State for showing action menu\n  const [showActions, setShowActions] = useState(false);\n  const actionMenuScale = useSharedValue(0);\n  // Track long press\n  const longPressTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n\n  // Memoize current configuration to avoid unnecessary recalculations\n  const config = useMemo(() => fabConfig[currentTab], [currentTab]);\n  const IconComponent = config.IconComponent;\n\n  // Safe haptic feedback wrapper\n  const triggerHaptic = useCallback(async () => {\n    try {\n      await Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Haptic feedback not available');\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // Pan responder for drag functionality\n  const panResponder = useRef(\n    PanResponder.create({\n      onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,\n      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_, gestureState) => {\n        return isDragging || Math.abs(gestureState.dx) > 5 || Math.abs(gestureState.dy) > 5;\n      },\n      onPanResponderGrant: () => {\n        longPressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {\n          setIsDragging(true);\n          triggerHaptic();\n          // Slight lift effect\n          pressScale.value = withSpring(1.1);\n        }, LONG_PRESS_DURATION);\n      },\n      onPanResponderMove: (_, gestureState) => {\n        if (isDragging) {\n          translateX.value = baseX.current + gestureState.dx;\n          translateY.value = baseY.current + gestureState.dy;\n        }\n      },\n      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gestureState) => {\n        if (longPressTimer.current) {\n          clearTimeout(longPressTimer.current);\n          longPressTimer.current = null;\n        }\n\n        if (isDragging) {\n          baseX.current += gestureState.dx;\n          baseY.current += gestureState.dy;\n          setIsDragging(false);\n          // Spring back slightly on release (bubble effect)\n          pressScale.value = withSpring(1.0);\n\n          // Optional: Snap back if near edge? For now, free floating.\n        } else {\n          const moved = Math.abs(gestureState.dx) > 5 || Math.abs(gestureState.dy) > 5;\n          if (!moved) {\n            handlePress();\n          }\n        }\n      },\n    }),\n  ).current;\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION INITIALIZATION\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!disabled && !isReduceMotionEnabled) {\n      breathingScale.value = 0.95;\n      breathingScale.value = withRepeat(\n        withTiming(1.02, {\n          duration: 3000,\n          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),\n        }),\n        -1,\n        true,\n      );\n    } else {\n      breathingScale.value = withTiming(1.0, { duration: 200 });\n    }\n  }, [disabled, isReduceMotionEnabled]);\n\n  // ============================================================================\n  // ANIMATION STYLES\n  // ============================================================================\n\n  const breathingStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: breathingScale.value }],\n    };\n  });\n\n  const pressStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: pressScale.value }],\n    };\n  });\n\n  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {\n    if (disabled) return;\n\n    if (actions && actions.length > 0) {\n      triggerHaptic();\n      setShowActions(!showActions);\n      actionMenuScale.value = withSpring(showActions ? 0 : 1, {\n        damping: 15,\n        stiffness: 150,\n      });\n      announce(showActions ? 'Actions menu closed' : 'Actions menu opened');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (onPress) {\n      triggerHaptic();\n      pressScale.value = withSequence(\n        withTiming(0.85, { duration: 100 }),\n        withSpring(1.0, { damping: 12, stiffness: 200 }),\n      );\n      onPress();\n    }\n  }, [disabled, onPress, actions, showActions, triggerHaptic]);\n\n  const actionMenuStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ scale: actionMenuScale.value }, { translateY: -10 }], // Pop up slightly\n      opacity: actionMenuScale.value,\n    } as any;\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    actionMenuScale.value = withSpring(showActions ? 1 : 0, {\n      damping: 15,\n      stiffness: 150,\n    });\n  }, [showActions]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return () => {\n      if (longPressTimer.current) {\n        clearTimeout(longPressTimer.current);\n      }\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const scrollStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    if (!scrollY) return {};\n    return {\n      transform: [\n        {\n          translateY: interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, 100], [0, 100], Extrapolate.CLAMP),\n        },\n      ],\n      opacity: interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, 50, 100], [1, 0.5, 0], Extrapolate.CLAMP),\n    };\n  });\n\n  const dragStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    return {\n      transform: [{ translateX: translateX.value }, { translateY: translateY.value }],\n    } as any;\n  });\n\n  const containerStyle = useMemo(\n    () => [\n      styles.container,\n      { bottom: bottomInset }, // Override bottom with prop\n      breathingStyle,\n      pressStyle,\n      scrollStyle,\n      dragStyle,\n      disabled && styles.disabled,\n    ],\n    [bottomInset, breathingStyle, pressStyle, scrollStyle, dragStyle, disabled],\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <Animated.View\n      {...panResponder.panHandlers}\n      style={containerStyle}\n      accessible={true}\n      accessibilityRole=\"image\" // The FAB itself is an image/button\n      accessibilityLabel={config.label}\n      accessibilityHint={actions && actions.length > 0 ? 'Double tap to view actions' : undefined}\n      accessibilityState={{ disabled, expanded: showActions }}\n      accessibilityActions={[{ name: 'activate', label: 'Activate' }]}\n      onAccessibilityAction={handlePress}\n    >\n      <View style={styles.contentContainer}>\n        {/* Glow Behind */}\n        <View style={styles.glow} />\n\n        {/* Lotus Image */}\n        <Image source={LOTUS_IMAGE} style={styles.lotusImage} resizeMode=\"contain\" />\n\n        {/* Optional Icon Overlay */}\n        {icon && (\n          <View style={styles.iconOverlay}>\n            <>{icon}</>\n          </View>\n        )}\n      </View>\n\n      {/* Action Menu */}\n      {actions && actions.length > 0 && (\n        <Animated.View style={[styles.actionMenu, actionMenuStyle]}>\n          {actions.map((action, index) => (\n            <Pressable\n              key={index}\n              style={styles.actionBubble}\n              onPress={() => {\n                triggerHaptic();\n                action.onPress();\n              }}\n              accessible={true}\n              accessibilityRole=\"button\"\n              accessibilityLabel={action.label}\n            >\n              <View style={styles.actionBubbleContent}>\n                {action.icon && (\n                  <action.icon size={18} color={Theme.colors.lotusDeepPink} strokeWidth={2} />\n                )}\n                <Text style={styles.actionLabel}>{action.label}</Text>\n              </View>\n            </Pressable>\n          ))}\n        </Animated.View>\n      )}\n    </Animated.View>\n  );\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// STYLES\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst styles = StyleSheet.create({\n  container: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    // bottom set dynamically\n    right: Theme.spacing.lg,\n    zIndex: Theme.zIndex.fab,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  contentContainer: {\n    width: FAB_SIZE,\n    height: FAB_SIZE,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  lotusImage: {\n    width: '100%',\n    height: '100%',\n    zIndex: 2,\n    backgroundColor: 'transparent',\n  },\n  iconOverlay: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    zIndex: 3,\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'center',\n  },\n  glow: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    width: FAB_SIZE * 0.8,\n    height: FAB_SIZE * 0.8,\n    borderRadius: FAB_SIZE,\n    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.sanctuarySaffron,\n    opacity: 0.4,\n    shadowColor: Theme.colors.sanctuarySaffron,\n    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 0 },\n    shadowOpacity: 0.8,\n    shadowRadius: 20,\n    elevation: 10,\n    zIndex: 1,\n  },\n  disabled: {\n    opacity: 0.5,\n  },\n  actionMenu: {\n    position: 'absolute',\n    bottom: FAB_SIZE + ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING,\n    right: 0,\n    alignItems: 'flex-end',\n  },\n  actionBubble: {\n    backgroundColor: Theme.colors.ink,\n    borderRadius: 24,\n    marginBottom: ACTION_BUBBLE_SPACING,\n    paddingHorizontal: 16,\n    paddingVertical: 10,\n    ...Theme.shadows.md,\n    minWidth: 100,\n    borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',\n    borderWidth: 1,\n  },\n  actionBubbleContent: {\n    flexDirection: 'row',\n    alignItems: 'center',\n    justifyContent: 'flex-end',\n    gap: 8,\n  },\n  actionLabel: {\n    color: Theme.colors.sacredWhite,\n    fontSize: 14,\n    fontWeight: '600',\n  },\n});\n\nexport default (\n        <ImageBackground source={{ uri: thumbnailUrl }} className=\"flex-1\" resizeMode=\"cover\">\n          <CardOverlay\n            title={title}\n            creator={creator}\n            resourceCount={resourceCount}\n            subjectTag={subjectTag}\n            verified={verified}\n            onPullToDesk={onPullToDesk ? () => onPullToDesk(contextData as T) : undefined}\n          />\n        </ImageBackground>\n      ) : (\n        <VStack className=\"flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-phase-surface\">\n          <BookOpen className=\"text-phase-accent opacity-50\" size={44} />\n          <CardOverlay\n            title={title}\n            creator={creator}\n            resourceCount={resourceCount}\n            subjectTag={subjectTag}\n            verified={verified}\n            onPullToDesk={onPullToDesk ? () => onPullToDesk(contextData as T) : undefined}\n            absolute\n          />\n        </VStack>\n      )}\n    </Box>\n  );\n\n  if (onPress) {\n    return (\n      <Pressable onPress={() => onPress(contextData as T)} className=\"rounded-3xl mr-4\">\n        {cardContent}\n      </Pressable>\n    );\n  }\n  return <Box className=\"rounded-3xl mr-4\">{cardContent}</Box>;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// INTERNAL: OVERLAY\n// ============================================================================\n\ninterface OverlayProps {\n  title: string;\n  creator: string;\n  resourceCount: number;\n  subjectTag: string;\n  verified: boolean;\n  onPullToDesk?: () => void;\n  absolute?: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction CardOverlay({\n  title,\n  creator,\n  resourceCount,\n  subjectTag,\n  verified,\n  onPullToDesk,\n  absolute = false,\n}: OverlayProps) {\n  return (\n    <VStack\n      className={`\n                flex-1 justify-between p-3\n                ${absolute ?       <Text className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-white tracking-widest uppercase\">\n            {subjectTag}\n          </Text>\n        </Box>\n        {verified && (\n          <HStack '')\n      .join('') || 'A'\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function DeviceAccountManager({\n  title = 'Shared device accounts',\n  subtitle = 'Switch between accounts stored on this device, protect them with a PIN, and remove them locally when needed.',\n  compact = false,\n}: {\n  title?: string;\n  subtitle?: string;\n  compact?: boolean;\n}) {\n  const {\n    accounts,\n    activeAccountId,\n    busyAccountId,\n    loading,\n    switchAccount,\n    removeAccount,\n    refresh,\n  } = useDeviceAccounts();\n  const { showToast } = useSanctuaryToast();\n  const [pinProtectedIds, setPinProtectedIds] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});\n  const [pinAction, setPinAction] = useState<PendingPinAction>(null);\n  const [pinBusy, setPinBusy] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let cancelled = false;\n\n    (async () => {\n      const entries = await Promise.all(\n        accounts.map(\n          async (account) =>\n            [account.accountId, await accountPin.hasPin(account.accountId)] as const,\n        ),\n      );\n\n      if (cancelled) return;\n      setPinProtectedIds(Object.fromEntries(entries));\n    })();\n\n    return () => {\n      cancelled = true;\n    };\n  }, [accounts]);\n\n  const accountLabel = (account: DeviceAccountRecord) =>\n    account.fullName || account.email || 'This account';\n\n  const askForPin = (mode: AccountPinModalMode, account: DeviceAccountRecord) => {\n    hapticLight();\n    setPinAction({ mode, account });\n  };\n\n  const handleSwitch = async (account: DeviceAccountRecord) => {\n    const protectedByPin = !!pinProtectedIds[account.accountId];\n    if (protectedByPin) {\n      askForPin('verify', account);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setPinBusy(true);\n    try {\n      await switchAccount(account.accountId);\n      hapticSuccess();\n      showToast?.({ message: `Switched to ${accountLabel(account)}`, type: 'success' });\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      showToast?.({ message: error?.message ??       setPinBusy(true);\n          try {\n            await proceed();\n          } finally {\n            setPinBusy(false);\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    ]);\n  };\n\n  const showToast?.({\n          message: `Removed ${accountLabel(account)} from this device`,\n          type: 'success',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      hapticError();\n      showToast?.({ message: error?.message ?? der border-phase-border bg-phase-surface ${compact ? 0 : 1, {\n      damping: 15,\n      stiffness: 90,\n    });\n\n    if (onEdit) onEdit();\n    if (onViewFullProfile) onViewFullProfile();\n  };\n\n  const frontStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => {\n    const rotateValue = interpolate(isFlipped.value, [0, 1], [0, 180]);\n    return {\n      transform: [{ rotateY: `${rotateValue}deg` }],\n      opacity: interpolate(isFlipped.value, [0, 0.5, 1], [1, 0, 0]),\n      zIndex: isFlipped.value < 0.5 ? LotusPetalFAB: FC<LotusPetalFABProps> = ({\n  currentTab: propTab,\n  onPress: propPress,\n  icon: customIcon,\n  actions: propActions,\n  scrollY,\n  disabled = false,\n  bottomInset = 24,\n  hasActiveGaps: propGaps,\n  gapPriority: propPriority,\n  onBreathingReset: propReset,\n  useGlobal = true,\n  className,\n}) => {\n  const { state: globalState } = useFAB();\n  const { const actions = propActions || globalState.actions;\n  const hasActiveGaps = propGaps ?? globalState.hasActiveGaps;\n  const onPress = propPress || globalState.onPress;\n  const onBreathingReset = fabConfig[currentTab] || fabConfig.self, [currentTab]);\n\n  // Reanimated Shared Values\n  const pressScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  const breathingScale = useSharedValue(1);\n  const pulseOpacity = useSharedValue(0.4);\n\n  // Position Shared Values for Draggability\n  const positionX = useSharedValue(0);\n  const positionY = useSharedValue(0);\n  const dragStartX = useRef(0);\n  const dragStartY = useRef(0);\n\n  const [isDrawerVisible, setIsDrawerVisible] = useState(false);\n\n  const clampFabToViewport = useCallback(\n    (x: number, y: number) => {\n      const windowDims = Dimensions.get('window');\n      const maxX = Math.max(FAB_EDGE_MARGIN, windowDims.width - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN);\n      const maxY = Math.max(\n        FAB_EDGE_MARGIN,\n        windowDims.height - FAB_SIZE - FAB_EDGE_MARGIN - (bottomInset + bottomTabPadding),\n      );\n      return {\n        x: Math.max(FAB_EDGE_MARGIN, Math.min(maxX, x)),\n        y: !== 'web') return;\n    try {\n      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;\n      window.localStorage.setItem(FAB_WEB_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ x, y }));\n    } catch         if (raw) {\n            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n            if (typeof parsed?.x === 'number' && typeof parsed?.y === 'number') {\n              const next =   } catch {\n        // Ignore and use default position\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!initialized) {\n      setDefaultPosition();\n    }\n  }, [clampFabToViewport, positionX, positionY, dragStartX.current = positionX.value;\n        dragStartY.current = positionY.value;\n        pressScale.value = withSpring(1.1);\n        hapticLight();\n      },\n      onPanResponderMove: (_, positionY.value = next.y;\n      },\n      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gesture) => {\n        pressScale.value = withSpring(1);\n\n        // Tap\n        if (\n          Math.abs(gesture.dx) < clampFabToViewport(positionX.value, positionY.value);\n        positionX.value = withSpring(next.x, { damping: 15 });\n        positionY.value = withSpring(next.y, { damping: 15 });\n        persistWebPosition(next.x, next.y);\n      },\n    }),\n  ).current;\n\n  // Breathing Animation\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!disabled && !isReduceMotionEnabled) {\n      breathingScale.value = left: positionX.value,\n    top: positionY.value,\n    transform: [{ scale: pressScale.value }],\n  }));\n\n  const breathingStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({\n    transform: [{ scale: breathingScale.value }],\n    opacity: pulseOpacity.value,\n  }));\n\n  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {\n    if (disabled) return;\n    hapticLight();\n\n    if (actions && actions.length > 0) (\n            <Icon size={32} className=\"text-phase-accent\" />\n          ) : (\n            <Sparkles size={32} className=\"text-phase-accent\" />\n          )}\n        </Box>\n\n        <VStack className=\"items-center gap-1\">\n          <Heading className=\"text-lg text-center text-phase-text-primary\">\n            {title || messages.title}\n          </Heading>\n          <Text className=\"text-sm text-center text-phase-text-secondary leading-relaxed\">\n            {description || messages.desc}\n          </Text>\n        </VStack>\n\n        {onAction && (\n          <SanctuaryButton\n            action=\"primary\"\n            onPress={() => {\n              hapticLight();\n              onAction();\n            }}\n            className=\"px-8\"\n          >\n            {actionLabel || messages.action}\n          </SanctuaryButton>\n        )}\n      </VStack>\n    </Center>\n  );\n};\n\nexport default PositiveInvitation;\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\ProgressIndicator.tsx","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Naween\\projects\\polymath-platform\\packages\\ui\\src\\components\\QRCodeGenerator.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"react-hooks/rules-of-hooks","severity":1,"message":"React Hook \"useMemo\" is called conditionally.
